en.description: Embark on an epic adventure full of whimsy, wonder, and high-powered weaponry! Roll your own multiclass hero then shoot, loot, slash, and cast on a quest to stop the Dragon Lord.

games.name: Late Shift
genres: フルモーションビデオ
選択方式アドベンチャー
games.description: 『レイト・シフト』はフルモーションビデオの犯罪サスペンスゲームです。

trailers.name: Late Shift - Announcement Trailer HD - New

en.name: Late Shift
en.description: Late Shift is a high stakes FMV crime thriller. Forced into a brutal London heist, your choices matter in this interactive cinematic experience with adaptable storylines that lead to one of seven conclusions. Your decisions are you.

games.name: アサシン クリード ユニティ
games.shortName: アサシン クリード ユニティ
games.description: 1789年、パリ。このアクションアドベンチャーゲームで、アルノ・ドリアンの視点からフランス革命を体験しよう。アサシンとなり、国家の運命をかけて、革命の背後に潜む真の権力を暴け。

trailers.name: Assassin's Creed Unity - E3 2014 Trailer - English

en.name: Assassin's Creed® Unity
en.description: Paris, 1789. In this action-adventure game, experience the French Revolution through the eyes of Arno Dorian. Become an Assassin and expose the true powers behind the Revolution for the fate of a nation.

games.name: Astrometica
genres: 宇宙シミュレーション
games.description: Astrometicaは、宇宙探査と基地建設のサバイバルゲームです。大惨事の後、宇宙を探検し、資源を集め、基地を建設して宇宙の謎を解き明かしましょう。高度な技術を使い、ツールを作成し、新しい設計図を発見して生き残りましょう。

en.name: Astrometica
en.description: Astrometica is a space exploration and base-building survival game. After a catastrophic event, explore vast space, gather resources, build bases, and uncover cosmic mysteries. Use advanced technology, craft tools, and discover new blueprints to survive and thrive in the unknown.

games.name: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition
games.shortName: PATHFINDER: WRATH OF THE RIGHTEOUS - ENH
games.description: Embark on a journey to a realm overrun by demons in a new epic RPG from the creators of the critically acclaimed Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Explore the nature of good and evil, learn the true cost of power, and rise as a Mythic Hero capable of deeds beyond mortal expectations.

en.name: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition
en.description: Embark on a journey to a realm overrun by demons in a new epic RPG from the creators of the critically acclaimed Pathfinder: Kingmaker. Explore the nature of good and evil, learn the true cost of power, and rise as a Mythic Hero capable of deeds beyond mortal expectations.

games.name: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator
games.shortName: TAXI LIFE: A CITY DRIVING SIMULATOR
games.description: 愛車と会社のアクセル全開！お客を運んで街を駆け、会社をどんどん大きくしよう！眠らない街バルセロナ。毎日降りかかるチャレンジをクリアして、一流のタクシードライバーを目指そう！

en.name: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator
en.description: Climb into the driver's seat of your car and your business, transport passengers across Barcelona and grow your company! Can you help relieve the transportation challenges of a city that never sleeps?

games.name: 巨人殺し: 冥界の怒涛
games.shortName: 巨人殺し: 冥界の怒涛
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 終わりなき敵の波を斬り伏せ、戦斧を掲げて運命の洗礼に立ち向かえ！『巨人殺し: 冥界の怒涛』では、押し寄せる敵の大群に挑み、戦いを通じて自らを鍛え上げ、神々の祝福を手に入れることができます。凡人の枠を超え、巨人に抗う不滅の戦士となり、不屈の地底世界に輝かしい伝説を刻みましょう！

trailers.name: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Conan DLC & Local Co-Op Launch Trailer  JP
Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel - Official Launch Trailer | PC & Consoles

en.name: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
en.description: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Viking Deities, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

games.name: Night of the Dead
genres: オープンワールドサバイバルクラフト
games.description: 「ナイト·オブ·ザ·デッド」は探検、タワーディフェンス、生存、クラフティングなど多くの要素が合わさったオープンワールドゲームです。 ゾンビが支配する世界を駆け回りながら、様々な資源と強力な装備を収集してください。毎晩押し寄せるゾンビの群れから生き残るための防御線を構築してください！

en.name: Night of the Dead
en.description: 'Night of the Dead' is an open-world game that combines elements of exploration, tower defense, survival, and crafting. Traverse a world dominated by zombies while collecting various resources and powerful equipment. Build a fortress to survive the hordes of zombies that swarm every night!

games.name: アサシン クリード シンジケート
games.shortName: アサシン クリード シンジケート
games.developer: Ubisoft Quebec, in collaboration with Ubisoft Annecy, Bucharest, Kiev, Montreal, Montpellier, Shanghai, Singapore, Sofia, Toronto studios
games.description: 1868年、ロンドン。産業革命真っ直中の時代に地下組織を率いて、腐敗した支配を打ち砕け。アクション、陰謀、そして血にまみれた戦いが待ち受ける。

en.name: Assassin's Creed® Syndicate
en.description: London, 1868. Lead your underworld organization in the midst of the Industrial Revolution to break the corrupt stranglehold on the city in a visceral adventure filled with action, intrigue, and brutal combat.

games.name: Enotria: The Last Song
games.description: 『Enotria: The Last Song』はイタリアの伝承に基づいて作られた、まばゆい日の光が影を生み出す美しい世界を舞台としたソウルライク・アクションRPG。異なる役を持つ仮面を身に着け、恐ろしい敵に立ち向かい、アルドーレの力を用いて現実を捻じ曲げ、終わりなき演劇の中に閉じ込められた地――エノトリアの謎を解き明かそう

trailers.name: Enotria: The Last Song Launch Trailer
Enotria: The Last Song Cinematic Trailer
Enotria: The Last Song Gameplay Showcase

en.name: Enotria: The Last Song
en.description: Enotria: The Last Song is a soulslike set in a beautiful sun-lit world inspired by Italian folklore where the brightest sun casts the darkest shadow. Wear unique role-altering masks, face formidable foes and alter reality with the power of Ardore to unravel the secrets of Enotria.

games.name: 呪術廻戦 戦華双乱
games.shortName: 呪術廻戦 戦華双乱
games.description: 『呪術廻戦』に登場するお馴染みの呪術師や呪霊たちの“呪術”を使いこなして、パートナーと共に「高み」を目指す2vs2の呪術連携アクションゲーム。

trailers.name: 20240119_マルチ_呪術廻戦_戦華双乱_ローンチPV_fullbit_master

en.name: Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash
en.description: Master the Jujutsu of your favorite Sorcerers and Cursed Spirits! Bring a friend and dive into the world of JUJUTSU KAISEN in this action-packed, 2-on-2 fighting game!

games.name: Settlement Survival
games.description: 一群の生存者を率いて新しい故郷を築く都市建設ゲーム。地形を作り替え、限られた資源をやりくりし、農作物を育て、動物を狩り、資源を集め、交易を行い、そして輝かしいあなただけの町を造ろう。

en.name: Settlement Survival
en.description: In this city-building game, you will lead a group of survivors in their search for a new home. Manipulate the landscape, manage limited supplies, plant crops, hunt wildlife, gather resources, and develop trade routes to build a bustling and unique town.

games.name: 泣き叫ぶ雁
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
games.description: 『泣き叫ぶ雁』は残酷な時代背景と美しい悲恋を描いたビジュアルノベル。最愛の人を失った書生・方知宥は、自らが書いた小説の世界・「獅駝国」に迷い込む。亡き幼馴染とそっくりな謎の少女を守るため、彼は十日間に及ぶ虐殺をなんとか生き延び、失われた記憶を取り戻して幼馴染である名妓の死の謎を解き明かしていく。

en.name: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall
en.description: A visual novel of brutal beauty and tragic love. You wake up trapped inside your own dark fantasy, Lion Camel Kingdom. To escape a ten-day demon massacre, you must survive and recover your memories to solve the mystery of a drowned Yangzhou courtesan.

games.name: Carry The Glass
genres: パズルプラットフォーム
games.description: ちょっと変わった建設作業員コンビになって、楽しい2人協力アクションゲームに挑戦しよう！壊れやすい窓ガラスを運びながら、チャレンジ満載のカラフルなステージを進もう。声をかけ合い息を合わせて、障害物をかわし、パズルを解こう。ガラスを割らずに仕事をやり遂げられるかな？

en.name: Carry The Glass
en.description: Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer! Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges. Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles. Can you finish the job without breaking the glass?

games.name: ROUTINE
games.description: 『ROUTINE』は、80年代の未来観に基づく月面基地の廃墟を舞台にした、一人称視点のSFホラーゲームだ。未知の脅威をかいくぐりながら、基地内を探索、調査せよ。

en.name: ROUTINE
en.description: ROUTINE is a First Person Sci-Fi Horror set on an abandoned lunar base designed around an 80s vision of the future. Explore and investigate your surroundings as you survive against unknown threats.

games.name: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
games.shortName: BORDERLANDS GAME OF THE YEAR ENHANCED
games.description: 協力型ハックアンドスラッシュシューティングの元祖が、豊富な強化要素と共に登場！ それぞれに独自のRPGライクなスキルを持った4人の好戦的な傭兵から好きなキャラクターを選んだら、膨大な種類の武器を手に、砂漠の惑星パンドラで暴れ回ろう！

en.name: Borderlands Game of the Year Enhanced
en.description: Discover the original co-op shooter-looter, crammed with new enhancements! As one of 4 trigger-happy mercenaries with RPG progression, equip bazillions of guns to take on the desert planet Pandora.

games.name: Expeditions: Rome
games.description: ターン制RPGで外地を制圧し、政治的陰謀を操ってローマの運命を決めよう。近衛兵を直接動員して軍団を勝利に導き、ひとつひとつの選択が重大な意味を持つストーリーで自分の道を切り開こう。果たして君はローマの未来をどう形作るのだろうか？

en.name: Expeditions: Rome
en.description: Determine the destiny of Rome as you conquer foreign lands and navigate political intrigue in this turn-based RPG. Directly fight with your party of Praetorians, guide your legion to victory, and choose your own path in a story where every decision matters. How will you shape the future of Rome?

games.name: Operation: Tango
genres: 協力プレイキャンペーン
games.description: このCo-opプレイ型スパイゲームでは、2人で世界を救います。あなたを繋ぐのは自分の声だけ。エージェントもしくはハッカーとして友達とペアを組み、ハイテクな国際的脅威を打ち負かしましょう。無料コンテンツアップデートが登場！

en.name: Operation: Tango
en.description: It takes two to save the world in this cooperative spy adventure. Pair up with a friend as Agent or Hacker—with only your voices to connect you—and work together to bring a hi-tech global menace to its knees. Now with a FREE CONTENT UPDATE!

games.name: The Precinct
games.description: 1983年、アヴェルノ・シティ。ギャングが町を支配したままでは、亡くなった父も安らかには眠れない。ネオン・ノワール・アクションサンドボックス・ポリスゲームで、町を浄化し、真実を明らかにして、破壊可能なオブジェクトに満ちた環境でスリリングな大捕り物を始めよう。

en.name: The Precinct
en.description: Averno City, 1983. Gangs rule the streets and your father lies restless in his grave. Clean up the city, uncover the truth, and embark on thrilling vehicle chases through destructible environments in this neon-noir action sandbox police game.

games.name: UBOAT
games.description: UBOAT is a simulator of a submarine from WWII era. It is a survival sandbox with crew management mechanics while its primary theme is life of German sailors. The boat is their home, but it can become their grave at any time.

en.name: UBOAT
en.description: UBOAT is a simulator of a submarine from WWII era. It is a survival sandbox with crew management mechanics while its primary theme is life of German sailors. The boat is their home, but it can become their grave at any time.

games.name: Crab Champions
games.description: Claw your way across exotic islands combining fluid movement with fast paced combat to become a Crab Champion in this third person roguelike shooter.

en.name: Crab Champions
en.description: Claw your way across exotic islands combining fluid movement with fast paced combat to become a Crab Champion in this third person roguelike shooter.

games.name: Tricky Towers
games.description: 時は来た・・・。 光輝くローブと魔法の力でTricky Towerを組み上げろ！ あなたは神話の世界でレンガを積み上げる。 誰のTowerが最も安定していられるか？ 魔法を駆使すればさらにうまく組み立てることができ、 悪の魔法を受け流すこともできる。 この狂った物理世界で友達を競い合い、名声をも積み上げろ！

en.name: Tricky Towers
en.description: With your brilliant robe and magic powers, it’s time to build some Tricky Towers! Stack your bricks in this land of fable, whose marvelous tower will be the most stable? Battle your friends and rise to fame, in this frantic physics game.

games.name: Chef Life: A Restaurant Simulator
genres: 没入シミュレーション
games.description: 理想のレストランを建築し、運営しましょう！ メニュー、仕入れ、装飾、スタッフ、設備、客…それに忘れちゃいけないのが、そう、料理！レストランで日々を過ごし、ミシュランガイドで賞を受賞しましょう。

en.name: Chef Life: A Restaurant Simulator
en.description: Create and manage your dream restaurant! Menus, purchasing, décor, staff, equipment, customers… and don't forget the actual cooking! Experience the daily life of a restaurateur and earn your awards from the Michelin Guide.

games.name: Monument Valley
games.description: ありえない環境と幻想的なパズルのなかで、沈黙の姫アイダと一緒に赦しの旅に出かけましょう。瞑想的で心安らぐこのパズルゲームのなかでモニュメントを操作し、進化する道を創ることで、超現実的で新しい神秘的な世界を探索してください。

trailers.name: Monument Valley: Panoramic Collection - Cinematic Trailer
Monument Valley: Panoramic Edition Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Monument Valley
en.description: Embark on a journey of forgiveness through impossible environments and illusionary puzzles. Experience this meditative and calming puzzle game by manipulating monuments and creating evolving paths to explore new, surreal, and mysterious worlds.

games.name: WRC 7 FIA World Rally Championship
genres: 乗り物シミュレーション
games.description: 忠実に再現された舞台で、WRCの13のラリーに挑戦。ベストドライバーになりきって、新しい車のステアリングを握ろう。ひとりでもオンラインでも楽しめる。Epic Stagesに参加したり、ウイークリーチャレンジに挑戦したり、プロのようにWRCを体験しよう！

en.name: WRC 7 FIA World Rally Championship
en.description: Take on all the challenges of the 2017 World Rally Championship: the official cars and drivers, 13 countries, 52 Special Stages, every surface, more powerful cars, more demanding physics, longer races, and an eSports mode to keep you on the edge of your seat all year round.

games.name: Wayfinder
games.description: ウェイファインダーとなり、選んだ道とプレイスタイルに沿った力を解放し、世界を覆い尽くさんとする敵勢力を撃退しよう。仲間とともに繰り広げる果てしなき冒険をあなたが直接形作り、カスタマイズしていく協力型ARPG。ウェイファインダーは、友がいればより強くなるのだから。

en.name: Wayfinder
en.description: Become a Wayfinder, and unlock their powers as you choose your path and playstyle while pushing back a hostile force that has overtaken your world. A Co-Op ARPG where you directly shape and customize the endless adventures you go on with friends, because Wayfinders are stronger together.

games.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2
games.description: トーチとハンマーの埃を払って - 仕事に戻る時です、新しい仕事があります。世界最大級の船の墓場がある新しいビーチコーストを訪れ、巨大な船のパーツを解体し、貴重な鉄を何トンも集めましょう。腕まくりをして、仕事に戻る時間です。

trailers.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 - Submarines DLC x UBOAT
Ship Graveyard Simulator 2 - Steel Giants DLC x 30 Days on Ship

en.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2
en.description: Dust off your torch and hammer - it's time to get back to work, you have a new job to do. Visit the new beach coast with the largest, biggest ship graveyard in the world, dismantle huge ship parts and collect tons of precious steel. Roll up your sleeves, it's time to get back to the business.

games.name: Undisputed
games.description: Become Undisputed in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.

en.name: Undisputed
en.description: Become Undisputed in the most authentic boxing game to date! Featuring true to life visuals, bone-jarring action, and more licensed boxers than ever before, Undisputed gives you unprecedented control to master every inch of the ring.

games.name: The Drifter
games.description: A Pulp Adventure Thriller - A murdered drifter awakens. Alive again, seconds before his death. Hunted and haunted, help him untangle a mad web of conspiracy in this fast-paced point 'n click thrill-ride.

en.name: The Drifter
en.description: A Pulp Adventure Thriller - A murdered drifter awakens. Alive again, seconds before his death. Hunted and haunted, help him untangle a mad web of conspiracy in this fast-paced point 'n click thrill-ride.

games.name: Thief Simulator
games.description: Become the best thief. Gather intel, steal things and sell them to buy hi-tech equipment. Do everything that a real thief does.

en.name: Thief Simulator
en.description: Become the best thief. Gather intel, steal things and sell them to buy hi-tech equipment. Do everything that a real thief does.

games.name: Company of Heroes
games.description: Delivering a visceral WWII gaming experience, Company of Heroes redefines RTS by bringing the sacrifice of heroic soldiers, war-ravaged environments, and dynamic battlefields to life. Please visit the "Company of Heroes - Legacy Edition" page for additional user reviews.

en.name: Company of Heroes
en.description: Delivering a visceral WWII gaming experience, Company of Heroes redefines RTS by bringing the sacrifice of heroic soldiers, war-ravaged environments, and dynamic battlefields to life. Please visit the "Company of Heroes - Legacy Edition" page for additional user reviews.

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
games.description: 高い評価を受けた『プレイグ テイル』シリーズの、まったく新しい物語の続きを体験せよ。主人公ソフィアとしてミノタウロスの島を冒険し、知恵を駆使して危険な敵を出し抜き、いにしえの秘密を解き明かし、恐ろしい呪いの謎にせまり、神話の怪物たちと戦おう。

trailers.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Accolades Trailer
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - Story Trailer

en.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
en.description: Embark on an original story, prequel to the award-winning games: A Plague Tale. As Sophia, journey to the Minotaur’s Island, outsmart deadly foes, unravel ancient secrets, and confront a mythical creature at the heart of a devastating curse.

games.name: Is This Seat Taken?
games.description: こだわりの強いコミカルな「フォルムン」たちを相性に合わせて配置するロジックパズルゲーム。それぞれに好き嫌いがあり、ぴったりの席を見つけるのは楽しくも難しい。みんなにぴったりの場所を用意してあげれば、新たなステージがアンロックされる。愉快でありながら共感できる世界でリラックスしよう。

en.name: Is This Seat Taken?
en.description: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

games.name: Armello
genres: ターン制ストラテジー
games.description: アルメロは不気味な民話の世界をモチーフにしたボードゲームです。奥深く戦術的なカードゲームと、卓上のディープな戦略、RPG要素を組み合わせた、スリル満点の冒険に満ちています。シングルプレイヤーとマルチプレイヤーの戦闘に挑み、呪文をかけ、エージェントを採用し、玉座を目指したクエストで毒や罠を活用しよう！

en.name: Armello
en.description: Armello is a grim fairy-tale board game come to life, with every match combining deep, tactical card play, rich tabletop strategy and RPG elements. Leverage subterfuge, spells and careful strategy to wrangle control of the game's chaotic odds as you quest for the throne.

games.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018
genres: 乗り物シミュレーション
games.description: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018には、車の修理、塗装、チューニング、ドライビングに関する挑戦が詰まっています。 新しい納屋発見モジュールとジャンクヤード・モジュールで、クラシックでユニークな車を探しましょう。 カーエディターで自前の車を追加することもできます。

en.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2018
en.description: Build and expand your repair service empire in this incredibly detailed and highly realistic simulation game, where attention to car detail is astonishing. Find classic, unique cars in the new Barn Find module and Junkyard module. You can even add your self-made car in the Car Editor.

games.name: Wobbly Life
games.description: 『ウォブリー・ライフ』は、活気あふれるオープンワールド物理サンドボックス。オンラインまたはローカルの協力プレイで、友達とエキサイティングな仕事やミニゲーム、ちょっと変わったストーリーミッションをプレイしよう。ゲーム内のお金を稼げば、洋服や乗り物、家などを購入できる。さあ、ウォブリー・ワールドを探検しよう！

en.name: Wobbly Life
en.description: Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

games.name: Wild Assault / 兽猎突袭
genres: サードパーソンシューティング
games.description: 『Wild Assault』(ワイルドアサルト)は、アンリアルエンジン5を駆使して開発された20対20のマルチプレイヤー大戦場ヒーローシューティングゲームです。武装猫スタジオが手掛け、動物の英雄たちによる独特な戦争体験を提供することを目指して慎重に開発されています。ゲーム内では、プレイヤーは動物の英雄として躍り出し、多彩な武器や戦術スキルを駆使し、チームと一体となった協力を通じて、熱い戦場に挑むことが求められます。その勝利への道は、高揚感に満ちた戦闘アトムスフィア、銃器の射撃感、そして革新的な戦術スキルを通じて築かれています。

trailers.name: Wild Assault Official Launch Trailer: WA DEFENSE
Wild Assault Early Access Trailer: Embark

en.name: Wild Assault
en.description: Wild Assault is an anthro-themed tactical shooter built with Unreal Engine 5, featuring large-scale battlefield gameplay centered around Valiant abilities. Work closely with your team, harness your instincts, and charge into battle to secure victory.

games.name: Gremlins, Inc.
games.developer: Charlie Oscar Lima Tango Interactive Entertainment
games.description: この作品は、腐敗した資本主義者のグレムリン達が、スチームパンクの世界で金や権力、名声を求めて競い合うドキドキハラハラの戦略的ボードゲームです。盗んで脅して――シングルプレイや多人数プレイを、ランキング、ラダー制、チームモードや観戦モードと一緒に楽しみましょう。

en.name: Gremlins, Inc.
en.description: This is an intense strategy board game in a steampunk world of corrupt capitalist gremlins who compete for money, political power and prestige. Save and invest, steal and extort, arrest and get arrested – in single-player and multiplayer, with ranks and ladders, team mode and spectator mode.

games.name: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out
games.description: 「この刑務所に長く居すぎた。もうここから出よう。カーペットをめくってスプーンで掘り始めろ。看守に気をつけて、見つけたガラクタを売れ。囚人たちと取引して、より良いアイテムを手に入れ、ステータスを向上させろ。トンネルを広げ、発光スティックやダイナマイトを使え。君は脱出できるか？」

trailers.name: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out - Gameplay trailer

en.name: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out
en.description: Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats. Expand the tunnel, use glow sticks and dynamite. Will you escape?

games.name: マーベル ミッドナイト・サンズ
games.shortName: マーベル ミッドナイト・サンズ
games.description: マーベル・ユニバースのダークサイドで繰り広げられる戦いの中で、スーパーヒーローとして戦略を立て戦いに挑もう。 プレイヤーであるあなたは、伝説のデーモンスレイヤー「ハンター」として、スーパーヒーローと超人的な戦士たちを率いて、迫りくる脅威に立ち向かうのだ。

en.name: Marvel's Midnight Suns
en.description: FIGHT AND STRATEGIZE LIKE A SUPER HERO IN THE DARKER CORNERS OF THE MARVEL UNIVERSE. Play as The Hunter, a legendary demon slayer who must lead a team of Super Heroes and supernatural warriors facing apocalyptic threats.

games.name: CaseCracker（ケースクラッカー）
games.description: 余計な映像演出はない。あるのは、極限まで頭脳を刺激する推理だけ。複雑に絡み合う手掛かりの中から自ら情報を探し出し、照合を重ね、一本ずつ真相への糸をたぐり寄せていく。文字だけで挑むハードコア推理では、悪魔は常に細部に潜んでいる。さあ、名探偵。準備はできているか？

en.name: CaseCracker
en.description: No flashy visuals, just pure mental gymnastics. Actively search, cross-reference, and unravel the truth from a complex database. In this hardcore text-based deduction game, the devil is always in the details. Detective, are you ready?

games.name: Hand of Fate 2
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: ハンド オブ フェイト2ではディーラーにチャレンジするために新しい英雄が立ち上がります！何度でも探検をプレイできる生きたボードゲームをマスターしましょう。新しいカードをロック解除し、冒険を構築してから激しいリアルタイムの戦闘で敵を倒します！

en.name: Hand of Fate 2
en.description: A new hero rises to challenge the Dealer in Hand of Fate 2! Master a living boardgame of infinitely replayable quests - unlock new cards, build your adventure, then defeat your foes in brutal real-time combat! Draw your cards, play your hand and discover your fate!

games.name: Sid Meier's Civilization®: Beyond Earth™
genres: ターン制ストラテジー
games.description: Sid Meier’s Civilization: Beyond Earth is a new science-fiction-themed entry into the award winning Civilization series. As part of an expedition sent to find a home beyond Earth, lead your people into a new frontier, explore and colonize an alien planet and create a new civilization in space.

en.name: Sid Meier's Civilization®: Beyond Earth™
en.description: Sid Meier’s Civilization: Beyond Earth is a new science-fiction-themed entry into the award winning Civilization series. As part of an expedition sent to find a home beyond Earth, lead your people into a new frontier, explore and colonize an alien planet and create a new civilization in space.

games.name: Steelrising
games.description: 1789年、パリ。フランス革命はルイ16世とその配下である無慈悲な機械仕掛けの軍団により、血をもって鎮圧された。謎に包まれた最高傑作のオートマタ「アイギス」として、王の軍団に一人で立ち向かい、歴史を転換させることこそ、この高難易度アクションRPGの目的だ。

en.name: Steelrising
en.description: Paris, 1789. The French Revolution has been suppressed with bloodshed by Louis XVI and his merciless mechanical army. Aegis, a mysterious automaton masterpiece, must confront the king's army alone to save history in this challenging action-RPG.

games.name: Vampire Hunters
games.description: ヴァンパイアを狩るには銃が必要だ。たくさんの銃です。銃を積み重ねて、馬鹿げた過激なビルドを作り、アンデッドの生き物の大群をなぎ倒しましょう。このローグライト サバイバーズ FPS で、火力を解き放ち、大混乱を生き延びましょう。

en.name: Vampire Hunters
en.description: To hunt vampires, you'll need guns. Lots of guns. Mow down hordes of undead creatures by stacking your guns into absurd, over-the-top builds. Unleash your firepower and survive the mayhem in this Roguelite Survivors FPS.

games.name: ANIMAL WELL
games.description: 入り組んだ迷宮の中を探索し、多くの秘密を解き明かそう。アイテムを集めて、驚きかつ巧妙な手段で周囲の環境を上手く利用しよう。暗闇に潜むものたちより生き延びようとする中で、恐ろしくも美しい生き物たちと遭遇することになるだろう。ここには目に見えるもの以外の何かが存在する。

en.name: ANIMAL WELL
en.description: Explore a dense, interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter beautiful and unsettling creatures, as you attempt to survive what lurks in the dark. There is more than what you see.

games.name: ブラスフェマス 2
games.description: 『Blasphemous 2』では、悔悟者は再び「奇蹟」を相手に終わりなき戦いに身を投じる。謎と秘密で満ちた危険な新世界に飛び込み、目の前に立ちはだかる恐ろしい敵を切り裂いて、サイクルを終わらせよう。

en.name: Blasphemous 2
en.description: The Penitent One awakens as Blasphemous 2 joins him once again in an endless struggle against The Miracle. Dive into a perilous new world filled with mysteries and secrets to discover, and tear your way through monstrous foes that stand between you and your quest to end the cycle once and for all.

games.name: Monument Valley 3
games.description: Monument Valley 3で世界を変える冒険へと旅立とう。目を見張るようなイリュージョンや雰囲気のあるパズルに取り組むクエストを通じて、ヌーアを導こう。この神秘的な世界の秘密、そして聖なる光に隠された意味を解き明かすことができますか？

en.name: Monument Valley 3
en.description: Set sail for a world-changing adventure as you guide Noor in their quest through a series of mind-bending illusions and atmospheric puzzles. Can you unlock the secrets of the mysterious world – and the meaning behind the Sacred Light?

games.name: Friends vs Friends
games.description: 銃撃戦とデッキ構築を組み合わせた、乱戦必死の対戦型オンラインシューティングゲーム。キャラクターを選び、カード型の装備をアレンジして、魂をかけた戦いに挑め！

en.name: Friends vs Friends
en.description: A frantic, online PvP shooter that combines combat and deck building. Choose a character, customize your card-based loadout, and get ready for the fights of your life!

games.name: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: ギャンブル好きの町民たちで賑わう粗末な酒場を舞台に、ブラックジャック・ローグライク・アドベンチャーでバトルを繰り広げよう。エースカード、フェイスカード、タロットカード、ビジネスカードなどから、自分だけのデッキを構築しよう。

en.name: Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers
en.description: Battle your way through a seedy tavern filled with gambling addicted townspeople in this Blackjack Roguelike Adventure. From aces and face cards to tarot cards, business cards and more, create your unique deck to beat the house.

games.name: Mirthwood
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: 中世ファンタジーの世界に浸りながら、魅力的な旅に出かけ、凶暴な生き物に立ち向かおう。新しい家を建てて農業と交易の日々を過ごすか、それとも剣を手にして冒険者の道を歩むか。選択はあなた次第だ。

en.name: Mirthwood
en.description: Embark on an enchanting journey and brave ferocious creatures in an immersive medieval fantasy world. Will you settle a new homestead to live a life of farming and trade, or pick up the sword and take up the adventurers' path?

games.name: Ship of Fools
genres: ローカルマルチプレイヤー
games.description: 『Ship of Fools』は、ローグライクな協力航海ゲーム。出航し、群島の荒れ狂う海で大砲を操り、海のモンスターと戦おう。アクアポカリプスを止められるほどの愚か者になれるだろうか？

trailers.name: Ship of Fools | Alphy's Project Update Trailer

en.name: Ship of Fools
en.description: Ship of Fools is a seafaring cooperative roguelite. Set sail, man the cannons and battle sea monsters through the tempestuous seas of the Archipelago. Are you fool enough to stop the Aquapocalypse?

games.name: マジッククラフト Magicraft
games.shortName: マジッククラフト MAGICRAFT
games.description: 『Magicraft』は、想像を絶する魔法効果に合わせて様々な魔法を駆使するローグライクゲームで、超自由度の高い構築は開発者でも尽きることがありません。

en.name: Magicraft
en.description: "Magicraft" is a Roguelike game that uses a variety of spells to match unimaginable spell effects, and the construction of ultra-high degrees of freedom cannot even be exhausted by developers.

games.name: ミラージュフェザーズ / Mirage Feathers
games.shortName: ミラージュフェザーズ / MIRAGE FEATHERS
genres: レールシューティング
一騎当千方式シューティング
games.description: 「もしできるならの話だけど。いつか戦うために空を飛ぶんじゃなくって、何も考えないで空を飛べたらいいなって...考えてたのよ」

en.name: Mirage Feathers
en.description: 「Maybe one day, I won't have to fight when I fly.」

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.description: 脱出ゲームと協力型ゾンビシューターが融合した、サバイバルホラー。時は1998年──いにしえの呪いが解き放たれ、ビシック山に多くの人々が閉じ込められてしまう。単独または最大4人のチームで一帯を探索し、脱出の手がかりを見つけ、この恐怖からの生還を果たそう。

trailers.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak - The Meritocracy Update
Whisper Mountain Outbreak - The Geared-Up Update
Whisper Mountain Outbreak - The Cursed Update

en.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
en.description: Escape room meets co-op survival horror. The year is 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mount Bisik. Alone or with up to 4 players, you must explore, find clues, figure out a way to escape...and survive the horror.

games.name: Tank Mechanic Simulator
games.description: Tank Mechanic Simulatorとは第二次世界大戦の戦車、戦車の乗員と彼らが戦記への貢献についてのゲームです。

en.name: Tank Mechanic Simulator
en.description: Renovate & build II World War tanks. Experience highly detailed & realistic simulation game. Take tanks fully apart by using different tools. Transform them from rusty and ruined to fully working. Check them on the training ground, sell or put into your own museum.

games.name: Planet of Lana
genres: パズルプラットフォーム
games.description: 自然の恵みと冷たい機械の侵略の狭間で引き裂かれた世界で、ひとりの少女と仲間は、互いの絆に頼って生き延び、大切なものを守らなければならない。彼らの希望、喪失、そして愛の物語は、旅が終わったあともずっと皆の心に残るだろう。

en.name: Planet of Lana
en.description: In a world torn between nature’s grace and cold machine invasion, one girl and her companion must rely on their bond to survive and protect what they hold dear. Their story of hope, loss, and love will stay with you long after the journey ends.

games.name: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
games.description: オークを滅ぼせ！「Deathtrap」では狡猾にトラップを設置する戦略が求められ、三人称視点のカオスな戦闘が繰り広げられる。バトルを重ねるごとに強くなるウォーメイジとなり、ゲームをエンドレスに楽しもう。ソロまたは最大4人で、容赦ないオークの大群を撃退しよう。

en.name: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap
en.description: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap combines chaotic third-person combat with devious trap-laying strategy. Enjoy endless replayability as your War Mage grows stronger through roguelite progression. Repel relentless orc hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

games.name: デスクトップ小動物牧場
games.shortName: デスクトップ小動物牧場
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: 新しい小さなデスクトップ仲間に会いましょう！動物たちがあなたの仕事や勉強中に、眠ったり、かゆみをかいたり、ちょこちょこ走り回ったりします。上手に経営していけば、どんどん増えていき、さまざまな種類や色の動物たちが画面の下を占領するようになります！

en.name: Tiny Pasture
en.description: Meet your new little desk buddies! They’ll snooze, scratch, and scamper around while you work or study (don’t worry, they’ve been trained not to invade your workspace). If you’re good at animal management, they will occupy the bottom of your screen with different kinds and colors!

games.name: Alba: A Wildlife Adventure
games.description: たとえ小さな者であっても、大きな変化を起こすことができる。アルバと一緒に、美しい島と野生動物を救おう。それは世界が変わる始まりかもしれない。

en.name: Alba: A Wildlife Adventure
en.description: Even the smallest person can make a big difference. Join Alba, as she sets out to save her beautiful island and its wildlife. And possibly start a revolution.

games.name: Abyssus
games.description: 海の底に眠る文明。ロードアウトを選択し、その邪悪な民を蹴散らし、神のごとき力を振るおう。『Abyssus』はスピード感あふれる1～4人プレイヤー用FPSにローグライト要素を融合した、深海ブラインパンクアドベンチャーだ。

en.name: Abyssus
en.description: Choose your loadout, blast through the corrupted denizens of a sunken civilization, and wield godly powers in Abyssus – a fast-paced 1-to-4 players FPS and roguelite brinepunk adventure.

games.name: The Past Within
games.description: 『The Past Within』は、ラスティレイクがお届けする新しい協力プレイ体験です！信頼できる誰かと一緒にプレイしましょう。それぞれが過去と未来でプレイすることになります。周りをよく観察して、見たものを相手に伝えましょう。パズルを解いて、アルバート・ヴァンダーブームの策略を明らかにしてください。

trailers.name: The Past Within - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

en.name: The Past Within
en.description: The Past Within is the new co-op experience from Rusty Lake! Play together with someone you deem trustworthy: one in The Past, the other in The Future. Observe and communicate what you see around you. Solve the puzzles and uncover Albert Vanderboom’s plan.

games.name: Night in the Woods
games.description: NIGHT IN THE WOODSはキャラクターとの会話主体で進行する2Dアドベンチャーゲームです。魅力的な世界を走り回りさまざまなキャラクターと会話し、リアルな展開をお楽しみください。

en.name: Night in the Woods
en.description: NIGHT IN THE WOODS is an adventure game focused on exploration, story, and character, featuring dozens of characters to meet and lots to do across a lush, vibrant world.

games.name: SILLY POLLY BEAST - バカなポリーは鬼となって
games.shortName: SILLY POLLY BEAST - バカなポリーは鬼となって
games.description: 異界を舞台にした、ストーリー重視のシューター。激しい銃撃戦と恐るべき怪物たちがあなたを待ち受ける。これは、運命によって≪あの≫怪物と対峙した少女の物語。自由を手に入れるため、彼女はその本質を探ることを余儀なくされる。 自由を賭けた戦いで、あなたはどこまで進めるだろうか？

en.name: Silly Polly Beast
en.description: An otherworldly, story-driven shooter with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. This is the story of a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast - and in order to become free, she was forced to study its nature. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: Heroes of Hammerwatch II
games.description: 永続的継続要素によって拡張されたローグライトアクションRPG！自分だけの街を築き上げ、ヒーローをアップグレードして装備を固め、常に変容し続ける《ダーク・シタデル》に挑め―ソロでも、友達とのチームでも！

trailers.name: Heroes of Hammerwatch II - Epic Missions Update
Heroes of Hammerwatch II - Launch Trailer

en.name: Heroes of Hammerwatch II
en.description: A rogue-lite action-rpg that offers extensive persistent progression. Build your town, upgrade and equip your heroes, before taking on the ever-changing Dark Citadel - either solo or with a team of friends.

games.name: Tales from the Borderlands
games.description: 『テイルズ・フロム・ザ・ボーダーランズ』は過酷な環境を持つ惑星パンドラを舞台に『ボーダーランズ2』と『ボーダーランズ3』の間の出来事が描かれる5つのエピソード形式のゲームシリーズです。

trailers.name: Tales from the Borderlands Trailer - EN NR

en.name: Tales from the Borderlands
en.description: Tales from the Borderlands is a five-part episodic game set on the unforgiving world of Pandora between the events of Borderlands 2 and Borderlands 3. This is a story full of Borderlands' trademark humor, following two adventurers on their quest for greatness.

games.name: マルチーズとふわふわ温泉
games.shortName: マルチーズとふわふわ温泉
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: 動物たちが訪れる温泉を運営しよう！「マルチーズとふわふわ温泉」は、画面下で他の作業をしながら楽しめるリラックス系シミュレーションゲームです。異なる温度の浴槽や休憩エリアを配置して、さまざまな動物たちが心ゆくまでくつろげる空間を作りましょう。

en.name: Maltese's Fluffy Onsen
en.description: Run a bathhouse visited by animals! Maltese's Fluffy Onsen is a relaxing simulation game that you can enjoy while doing other tasks, as it sits at the bottom of your screen. Place baths with different temperatures and rest areas to help a variety of animal friends unwind.

games.name: Fireworks Mania - An Explosive Simulator
games.description: FIREWORKS MANIAは、花火で遊んだり、美しい花火ショーを作成したり、爆破させたりする小型版のカジュアルな爆発シミュレータゲームです。

en.name: Fireworks Mania - An Explosive Simulator
en.description: FIREWORKS MANIA is a small casual explosive simulator game where you play around with fireworks, create beautiful firework shows or just blow stuff up.

games.name: Draw & Guess
games.description: いろんなモードで最大16人まで遊べるオンラインのお絵かき伝言ゲームです。絵心とカンの良さ（悪さ？）が試されます！

en.name: Draw & Guess
en.description: An online party game of drawing and guessing for up to 16 players with a variety of modes. Bring out the best (or worst) of your drawing and guessing skills!

games.name: A Plague Tale: Requiem
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
games.description: Embark on a heartrending journey into a brutal, breathtaking world, and discover the cost of saving those you love in a desperate struggle for survival. Strike from the shadows or unleash hell with a variety of weapons, tools and unearthly powers.

trailers.name: A Plague Tale: Requiem - Accolades Trailer
A Plague Tale: Requiem - Launch Trailer
A Plague Tale: Requiem - Story Trailer

en.name: A Plague Tale: Requiem
en.description: Embark on a heartrending journey into a brutal, breathtaking world, and discover the cost of saving those you love in a desperate struggle for survival. Strike from the shadows or unleash hell with a variety of weapons, tools and unearthly powers.

games.name: Sushiamo
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 『Sushiamo』は寿司を握ってあり得ないほどのハイスコアを目指す、ローグライクデッキ構築ゲームです。 ユニークな食材、ソース、戦局を変える道具を見つけ、マップを進みながら狂気のコンボでゲームをぶっ壊そう！

en.name: Sushiamo
en.description: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

games.name: Danchi Days
games.description: Danchi Daysは平成レトロな団地ADV。認知症のおばあちゃんのために団地の夏祭り復活を目指す少女となり、クセつよご近所さん達をお祭りに招待していく。参加を断られても、団地やネットを探索し、参加に繋がる手がかりを探そう。参加者を集めていくにつれ、団地を巻き込むコミカルでときどきシリアスな物語が展開する。

en.name: Danchi Days
en.description: A game that goes beyond cozy: there's more than meets the eye to this story-focused adventure with narrative depth and novel game mechanics, where you convince 51 neighbors to come to a festival, explore an everyday world and browse a retro internet!

games.name: 生存者の錬金術
genres: ターン制ストラテジー
games.description: ホムンクルスを信じるな。さもなくば肉体を乗っ取られるぞ。工房で金属を精錬し、カードと魔符を構築せよ。命と理智を削りながら資源を算出し、理不尽な契約を破棄せよ。肉体を奪われる前に、自らの手で呪われし契りを断ち切るのだ！

trailers.name: Corpus et Spiritus - Release trailer  JP

en.name: Corpus et Spiritus
en.description: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder, where you must break free of a demonic pact... before your partner kills you. Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans, forming combos that will save your body, spirit and soul!

games.name: テニスの王子様　ぎゅ～っと！ ドキドキサバイバル Tie break ♡ game
games.shortName: テニスの王子様 ぎゅ～っと！ ドキドキサバイバル TIE BREAK ♡ GAM
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
games.description: 中学テニス全国大会を間近に控えた夏のある日。 絶海の孤島に強化合宿へ向かう選手達と同じ船に乗り合わせたあなたとその友人は突然の嵐に遭遇し、無人島に漂着してしまう。 必要最低限の道具しかない閉鎖空間でサバイバル生活を強いられるあなたと選手達。 果たして、無事に脱出することはできるのだろうか――？

en.name: The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion! Tie break ♡ game~
en.description: One summer day, just before the national junior tennis tournament, you and your friend board the same ship as players heading to a training camp. A sudden storm leaves you all stranded on a deserted island, where survival becomes unavoidable.

games.name: DISK-Y
games.description: 転校生の〈ユウ〉に学校を案内しよう。夢のように脈絡なく展開する物語の中で、彼女との奇妙な関係を描く短編サイコホラーノベル。 3.5インチフロッピーディスク1枚に収録された、実験的なレトロゲームのSteam版。

en.name: DISK-Y
en.description: Let's show〈Yuu〉, the new student, around school. A short psycho-horror visual novel depicting a mysterious relationship with her, unfolding without context like a dream. The Steam version of an experimental retro game designed to fit on a single 3.5-inch floppy disk.

games.name: Chivalware
games.description: 『Chivalware』は目まぐるしいタイルマッチ式アクションローグライトだ。グリッド状の戦場で、リアルタイムに反射神経と連携力が試される――攻撃を避け、タイルをマッチさせて武器をチャージし、最適なタイミングで攻撃せよ。

en.name: Chivalware
en.description: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: 日本史大戦
games.description: 日本史を統一せよ！ 歴史年表そのものが戦場になる「歴史年表ストラテジー」

en.name: Samurai Conqueror
en.description: Unify Japanese History! A Timeline Strategy Game Where History Itself Becomes the Battlefield.

games.name: Plague Inc：ザ・ボードゲーム
games.shortName: PLAGUE INC：ザ・ボードゲーム
genres: アウトブレイクシミュレーション
games.description: そうなんです。これは正真正銘、「ビデオゲームのボードゲームのビデオゲーム」です！ 世界中に感染を広げ、変異を重ねて致命的な症状を獲得し、ライバルの病原体と戦って人類を滅ぼしましょう。プレイヤー数2億人超の大ヒット作をもとにした、感染・進化・絶滅がテーマの1～4人用テーブルゲームです。

trailers.name: Plague Inc: The Board Game - Trailer

en.name: Plague Inc: The Board Game
en.description: Yes, this really is a video game of a board game of a video game! Spread across the world, evolve deadly symptoms and battle rival pathogens to wipe out humanity. An infectious single-player and multiplayer challenge based on the smash hit with over 200 million players.

games.name: Boss After Boss
games.description: Boss After Bossは、宝箱を壊して強力なスキルを手に入れ、次々と強くなるボスに挑むインクリメンタルゲームです。ステータスを強化し、高ティアの宝箱をアンロックして、各ボスの弱点を突きましょう。

en.name: Boss After Boss
en.description: Boss After Boss is a short incremental game about breaking chests, collecting powerful skills, and taking down increasingly dangerous bosses. Upgrade your stats, unlock higher-tier chests, build stronger skill combinations, and exploit each boss's weaknesses.

games.name: Pathos
games.description: Pathosは古き良きダンジョンRPGにインスパイアされたターン制ファンタジー・アドベンチャー。現代的なグラフィックとサウンド、タッチ中心の操作方式と共に、奥深く変化に富んだゲームプレイを体験せよ。豊富な選択肢からキャラクターをカスタマイズし、ランダムに生成される壮大な冒険に繰り出そう。

en.name: Pathos
en.description: Pathos is a turn-based fantasy adventure inspired by retro dungeon crawlers. Experience deep, emergent gameplay with modern graphics, sound and a touch-first interface. Extensively customise your character and embark on epic procedurally generated campaigns.

games.name: Worldkampf '72
games.description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

en.name: Worldkampf '72
en.description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

games.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
games.description: 『Horses of Hoofprint Bay』は、手描きで温かみのある2Dグラフィックの牧場経営シミュレーションです。馬のお世話をして筋力と自信をつけ、賞金のかかった競技に出場！かわいい仔馬を産ませ、美しい自然を駆け巡り、スタッフを雇って、夢の牧場を作りましょう！

en.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
en.description: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D barn buildup and simulation game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, explore beautiful trails, hire and manage staff and build the stable of your dreams!

games.name: トゥコニ：森を見守る者
games.shortName: トゥコニ：森を見守る者
games.description: ヒューッ——落ち葉を舞い散らせる秋風がひと吹き！ ドングリリュックを背負い、カサカサと落ち葉を踏む音とともに森を探索しましょう。ひらめきいっぱいのミニゲームで、動物たちの冬支度をお手伝い。出会った友達に温かいお茶をいれ、現実の疲れをそっと吹き消してみませんか？

en.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
en.description: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute & cozy puzzle adventure. Play as Traveller, a forest spirit on a special journey, as you explore magical hand-drawn locations, meet charming characters, solve handcrafted puzzles, collect herbs and tea recipes, and help the forest prepare for the coming winter.

games.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
games.description: 伝説に富み、心躍るアクションに満ちた雄大な世界、オーロリアを探索。新たな入植者でもベテランの冒険者でも、ArcheAge Chronicles ではプレイヤーを魅了する臨場感のある冒険が待ち構えている。

en.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
en.description: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.

games.name: Silica
games.description: 『Silica』は壮大かつリアリスティックな戦闘で FPS と RTS をうまく組み合わせています。人間またはエイリアンとして、地上で戦うか上空から指揮するかを選択してください。スリル満点のマルチプレイヤーバトルに飛び込むか、戦略的コマンドをマスターしましょう。生き残って征服する準備はできていますか？

en.name: Silica
en.description: Silica blends FPS and RTS in epic, photorealistic battles. Choose to fight on the ground or command from above as humans or aliens. Dive into thrilling multiplayer combat or master strategic command. Are you ready to survive and conquer?

games.name: Dungeon Rampage Remastered
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: Battle your way to victory in this 1-4 player co-op hack-n-slash dungeon crawler. Play as a dynamic cast of heroes slicing their way through dungeons, earning weapons and loot. Rampage past a gauntlet of enemies and destruction to end the evil Lord Dinglepus' reign!

en.name: Dungeon Rampage Remastered
en.description: Battle your way to victory in this 1-4 player co-op hack-n-slash dungeon crawler completely remastered! Play as a dynamic cast of heroes slicing their way through dungeons, earning weapons and loot. Rampage past a gauntlet of enemies and destruction to end the evil Lord Dinglepus' reign!

games.name: 泣キ魂
games.description: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.

en.name: Weeping Souls
en.description: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.

games.name: MyDear.exe
games.description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

en.name: MyDear.exe
en.description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

games.name: DESKTOP BUG KILLER
games.description: デスクトップを戦場にしたインクリメンタルシューティング！画面の四方から機械虫が次々と湧き出て、PC 本体を破壊しようと襲ってくる。様々な武器を手に取り、虫の大群を撃退しよう。 各ラウンドで虫を倒すとゴールドが手に入る。試合外で巨大なスキルツリーを解放し、武器・攻撃力・防御力・特殊能力を強化可能。可愛いアシスタントの援護を受けたり、デスクトップペットをアンロックして共に戦える！

en.name: DESKTOP BUG KILLER
en.description: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

games.name: SpellChain
games.description: ダイナミックなスペルクラフトシステムで自分だけの魔法を作り、組み合わせる一人称視点のアクション・ファンタジーRPG。敵対する王国で戦い、イベントを妨害し、魔力を高め、最終的に王を討ち倒そう。

en.name: SpellChain
en.description: Create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events and grow your magical powers on a quest to slay the king.

games.name: Slumber Realm
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 90年代にどっぷり浸かったダイスローグライクで、子どもの頃の恐怖と戦おう。たった1回のダイスロールでビルド全体が発動。ワイルドなコンボをつなぎ、ブロッコリーと戦い、懐かしい品々で自分の部屋を飾ろう。

en.name: Slumber Realm
en.description: Battle your childhood fears in a 90s-soaked dice roguelike. One die roll triggers your entire build. Chain wild combos, fight broccoli, and decorate your bedroom with nostalgic relics.

games.name: Crystalyn
games.description: Start with one bullet. End with hundreds. Crystalyn is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell looter shooter about pushing your build to its absolute limits. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, and turn their loot into unstoppable firepower.

en.name: Crystalyn
en.description: Start with one bullet. End with hundreds. Crystalyn is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell looter shooter about pushing your build to its absolute limits. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, and turn their loot into unstoppable firepower.

games.name: Way Too Many Eggs
games.description: 小さな農場が、気づけば卵でいっぱい！『Way Too Many Eggs』は、集めるほどにどんどん育つインクリメンタルゲーム。ニワトリを増やし、お手伝いを雇って、巨大卵をぱかん！スキルツリーの永続アップグレードで、次の周回はもっとにぎやかに。

en.name: Way Too Many Eggs
en.description: Way Too Many Eggs is an incremental game about turning a tiny chicken farm into egg-filled chaos. Collect eggs, grow your flock, hire helpers, crack giant eggs and unlock permanent upgrades in the skill tree!

games.name: Campfire Harmony
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: 小さなキツネが、あなたのデスクトップでキャンプ中。あなたが作業しているあいだ、キツネも一緒に働きます。キーやクリックのたびに薪を運び、マシュマロを焼いて星を集め、星でキャンプが育っていきます。休憩すればキツネもお昼寝。なでたり、水切りをしたり、友達2人をたき火に招いたりもできます。

en.name: Campfire Harmony
en.description: A little fox camps on your desktop and works while you work. Your keys and clicks keep it fetching firewood and roasting marshmallows for Stars, and every Star grows your camp. Take a break and it naps. Pet the fox, skip stones, and invite two friends to the fire.

games.name: 性无能者的空庭
genres: インタラクティブフィクション
games.description: Dry Spring Monologue is a chapter-based visual novel game that follows Lu Zimo. The story includes adult themes such as overtime work, insomnia, and performance reviews, as well as terrifying elements like living spaghetti.

en.name: Dry Spring Monologue
en.description: Dry Spring Monologue is a chapter-based visual novel game that follows Lu Zimo. The story includes adult themes such as overtime work, insomnia, and performance reviews, as well as terrifying elements like living spaghetti.

games.name: Kart League Manager
games.description: 4部リーグのカートチームの監督となり、選手たちを優勝へ導きましょう。6人の選手を育て、マップをピック＆バンし、4対4のスタート陣形とカートを決めたら、接触やスリップストリーム、最終ラップのブーストで逆転が起きるレースを見届けます。目指すは1部優勝。ウィンター個人戦では選手一人ひとりが輝きます。ソロでも友達とでも遊べます。

en.name: Kart League Manager
en.description: Manage a Division 4 kart team and lead your drivers to the title. Raise six drivers, ban and pick maps, set your 4v4 grid and karts, then watch bumps, drafts and last-lap boosts turn the race around. Climb to Division 1, or let each driver shine in the Winter Solo Cup. Play solo or with friends.

games.name: Last Inspection
games.description: あなたの新しい任務は、入居前の物件を点検することだ。中に何が待ち受けていようと関係ない — その責任はすべて、あなた一人の肩にかかる。仕事をきちんとこなせば、この点検が最後にならない可能性もある……

en.name: Last Inspection
en.description: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside — all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

games.name: 小贼修仙记
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

en.name: Get It Free
en.description: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

games.name: 琥珀末日
games.developer: SUAN JIANG GUO Network Technology Co., LTD
games.description: Amber of The End is a strategic card-based RPG. Dong Yue, about to start his second year of university, finds himself trapped in a time loop and reliving this unusual autumn.Meet intriguing friends, build unique card decks, defeat strong enemies, and find the truth hidden at the end of this autumn.

trailers.name: 策略卡牌RPG《琥珀末日》首发预告片
策略卡牌RPG《琥珀末日》玩法预告片

en.name: Amber of The End
en.description: Amber of The End is a strategic card-based RPG. Dong Yue, about to start his second year of university, finds himself trapped in a time loop and reliving this unusual autumn.Meet intriguing friends, build unique card decks, defeat strong enemies, and find the truth hidden at the end of this autumn.

games.name: Aetheris Core
genres: 見下ろし型シューティング
games.description: 個性豊かな機体を操り、アビリティ、アップグレード、50種類以上のレリックを組み合わせて画面を制圧するビルドを作り、多段階ボスや不安定なリフトに挑む、テンポの速い見下ろし型SFバレットヘブン・ローグライト。

en.name: Aetheris Core
en.description: A fast-paced top-down sci-fi bullet-heaven roguelite where you pilot distinct ships, stack abilities, upgrades, and 50+ relics into screen-clearing builds, then prove your strategy against multi-phase bosses and unstable Rift encounters.

games.name: LIMINOID
games.description: 『LIMINOID』は、夢のような境界領域を舞台にした没入型の一人称探索ゲームです。本来は存在してはならないはずのシュールな風景や迷宮のような構造物を探索し、その美しさを堪能しながら物語を進めていきましょう。

en.name: LIMINOID
en.description: LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

games.name: Missi
games.description: Missiは、水彩画のスタイルで描かれた心地よいポイント＆クリックゲームです。過去の冒険のヒントを使ってパズルを解きましょう。病気の子ネズミのために薬草を集めながら、キノコグモとカラス王を出し抜こう。

en.name: Missi
en.description: Missi is a cozy point & click game in a watercolor hand-drawn world. Solve puzzles together with a cute white mouse, using clues in sketches of past adventures. Try to trick the Mushroom Spider and the Crow King by collecting all medicinal herbs for her sick son.

games.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining
games.description: Just Keep Defending And Miningは、戦闘と資源収集を組み合わせたユニークなインクリメンタルゲームです。採掘と生存のバランスを取り、アップグレードに投資し、ラウンドごとに強くなり、新しい地域を解除して、Just Keep Defending and Mining。

trailers.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining Official Launch Trailer
Just Keep Defending And Mining Demo Trailer

en.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining
en.description: Just Keep Defending And Mining is a unique incremental game that combines combat and resource gathering. Balance mining and survival, invest into upgrades, grow stronger every round, unlock new regions, and Just Keep Defending and Mining.

games.name: Infi-Knight
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: A dark fantasy desktop-companion incremental that idles while you work, play, or browse. Play as a Knight cursed with immortality locked in endless battle against the undead. Grow stronger with every death, uncover the curses' secrets and the Knight's dark past, then break the cycle of undeath.

en.name: Infi-Knight
en.description: A dark fantasy desktop-companion incremental that idles while you work, play, or browse. Play as a Knight cursed with immortality locked in endless battle against the undead. Grow stronger with every death, uncover the curses' secrets and the Knight's dark past, then break the cycle of undeath.

games.name: Woolwater
games.description: Woolwaterは羊と柵と水のパズルゲーム。わずかな柵で逃げ道を閉じて、羊がのびのび歩ける放牧地を作りましょう。小川をせき止めれば、放牧地を広げる地面が増えるかもしれません。でも、羊の逃げ道が開くこともあります。

en.name: Woolwater
en.description: Woolwater is a puzzle game about sheep, fences and water. Give your sheep room to roam with only a few fences to keep them in. Blocking a stream can free up more land for your pasture — and open an escape route.

games.name: VOID PROFIT
genres: 宇宙シミュレーション
games.description: Fly a rented corporate vessel in a procedurally-generated universe, navigate risky routes, profit from changing markets before the opportunity disappears and you lose it all. Take jobs, navigate the markets, smuggle, lie. Do everything in order to keep flying.

en.name: VOID PROFIT
en.description: Fly a rented corporate vessel in a procedurally-generated universe, navigate risky routes, profit from changing markets before the opportunity disappears and you lose it all. Take jobs, navigate the markets, smuggle, lie. Do everything in order to keep flying.

games.name: TRAUMATA
games.description: TRAUMATA is pure, concentrated adrenaline! Dive into the underbelly of psychological horror where every secret brings you closer to ascension... or drags you into the abyss of madness. Fight off endless waves, master the ultimate action, and dominate the global leaderboards!

en.name: TRAUMATA
en.description: TRAUMATA is pure, concentrated adrenaline! Dive into the underbelly of psychological horror where every secret brings you closer to ascension... or drags you into the abyss of madness. Fight off endless waves, master the ultimate action, and dominate the global leaderboards!

games.name: Cat Caffeine
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: 画面の中で営業する、癒やしの放置系ASMR猫カフェ。 仕事中やくつろぎタイムに、料理を作ってお客さんに提供し、カフェを飾りつけましょう。

en.name: Cat Caffeine
en.description: A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen. Cook and serve customers dishes and decorate your café while you work or relax.

games.name: Sort Them Fish
games.description: Sort Them Fishは、2538匹の魚を正しい水槽へ戻していく、居心地のいい整理整頓シミュレーターです。水槽を満たし、アビリティを習得し、散らかったアクアリウムショップを美しく整った魚コレクションへ変えていきましょう。

en.name: Sort Them Fish
en.description: Sort Them Fish is a cozy organizing simulator where you return 2538 fish to their proper aquariums in a cluttered aquatics store. Fill the tanks, learn abilities and turn the chaos into a beautifully organized fish collection.

games.name: Abashed
games.description: 『Abashed』では、イサック (Issac) の混乱した心の中に足を踏み入れ、彼の過去の断片が目の前をよぎる様子を体験できます。パズルを解き、神秘的なキャラクターと出会い、現実を変えながら、最も恐れているものに立ち向かい、失踪したパートナーの真実を明らかにします。ただ、それは本当に真実なのでしょうか？

en.name: Abashed
en.description: Abashed lets you step into the troubled mind of Issac, as the fragments of his past flash before his eyes. Solve puzzles, meet mysterious characters, and alter reality as he faces his worst fears to uncover the truth behind his missing partner, or so he thought.

games.name: Lil Laundry Lane
games.description: Run a hand-painted little laundromat that's all yours. Take in orders from the neighborhood's regulars, tend each load with care, and sink into the soothing rhythm of cleaning clothes.

en.name: Lil Laundry Lane
en.description: Run a hand-painted little laundromat that's all yours. Take in orders from the neighborhood's regulars, tend each load with care, and sink into the soothing rhythm of cleaning clothes.

games.name: Swarm Harvest
games.description: Congratulations, you're hired! Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

en.name: Swarm Harvest
en.description: Congratulations, you're hired! Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

games.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath
games.description: 定位置から、スコープだけで狙うハンティング。ひとつの場所、ひと呼吸、一発の弾。自然を読み、弾道の落下を見越して、120のレベルで完璧な心臓への一撃を決めよう。エンドレス、デイリー、ガントレット、クレー射撃モードも収録。

en.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath
en.description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, allow for bullet drop and land the perfect heart shot across 120 levels, plus Endless, Daily, Gauntlet and Clay modes.

games.name: Cat Over Here!
games.description: 猫たちでいっぱいのスタイリッシュなモノクロ工場を巡る、心地よい3Dかくれんぼ！制限時間やペナルティは一切ありません。自分のペースで機械の裏や隅々までじっくり探索し、穏やかな時間を楽しみましょう。工場内に隠れたすべての猫を見つけ出せますか？

en.name: Cat Over Here!
en.description: A cozy 3D hunt through a stylish monochrome factory full of hidden cats! Slow down, explore every corner at your own pace, search behind machines, and enjoy a stress-free game of hide-and-seek. No timers, no rush—can you find every single cat hiding in the factory?

games.name: Sheepscape
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: 『Sheepscape』は、羊だけに焦点を絞った、心地よい牧場シミュレーション。犬を放って羊の群れを追い込み、手作業のミニゲームで毛を刈り、羊毛を売って、季節ごとに、より良い群れを育てましょう。はじめての泥だらけの牧草地から、スコットランドの広大なハイランド地方まで。羊飼いの仕事のすべてがここに。

en.name: Sheepscape
en.description: Sheepscape is a cozy, focused sheep-farming sim. Send your dog to round up the flock, shear them in a hands-on minigame, then sell the wool and breed a finer flock season after season. It's the whole craft of shepherding: from your first muddy field to the open highlands.

games.name: The Smiling Flesh
games.description: The Smiling Fleshは緊張感あふれるソロサバイバルホラー。朽ち果てたゴシック洋館に潜入し、謎を解き、プレイヤーの動きを学習する恐ろしい怪物の裏をかこう。宝を手に入れて脱出するか、それとも洋館の新たな犠牲者となるか。

en.name: The Smiling Flesh
en.description: Steal the treasure. Stay quiet. Escape a hunter that anticipates your next move. The Smiling Flesh is a first-person survival horror game where you solve the mansion’s puzzles, hide from its twisted owner, and evade a creature that can cut off your escape.

games.name: Build A Bot
games.description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

en.name: Build A Bot
en.description: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

games.name: Knight's Party
genres: ローカルマルチプレイヤー
games.description: Knight's Partyは、誰もが騎士になりたいのに、誰も何をしているのか分かっていない命がけのトーナメントゲーム。フレンドと大砲を撃ち、酒を注ぎ、王冠を奪い合い、手足を失いながら戦おう。生き残るのは簡単じゃない。

en.name: Knight's Party
en.description: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

games.name: Marketfield Idle
games.description: Marketfield Idle は、作物を育て、商品を売り、レシピを調理し、生産を自動化し、プレステージで強力なランを目指す、心地よいインクリメンタル農場ゲームです。1200以上のアップグレード、戦略ルート、豊富なシナジーがあります。

en.name: Marketfield Idle
en.description: Marketfield Idle is all about growing crops, selling goods, cooking recipes, automating production, and prestige into stronger runs in a cozy incremental farming game with 1200+ upgrades, strategy paths, and lots of synergies to discover.

games.name: Capy Farm
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: カピバラたちだけで運営するファームを作り上げる、短編インクリメンタルゲーム。畑を拡張し、生産を自動化して莫大な利益を稼ぎ、ライバルの農園を上回ってグランド・ハーベスト・コンペティションの優勝を目指しましょう。

en.name: Capy Farm
en.description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

games.name: SCHISM WORLD
games.description: Divide the world—and rule the fragments. A turn-based strategy game in the style of a digital board game, where diplomacy, economics, and tactics decide everything. Gather the shards of a shattered world, forge alliances, and redraw borders across a procedurally generated cosmos.

en.name: SCHISM WORLD
en.description: Divide the world—and rule the fragments. A turn-based strategy game in the style of a digital board game, where diplomacy, economics, and tactics decide everything. Gather the shards of a shattered world, forge alliances, and redraw borders across a procedurally generated cosmos.

games.name: Creative Aquarium
games.description: あなたの落書きが、デスクトップの片隅で命を宿したら？『クリエイティブ・アクアリウム』は、描いた魚が世界にひとつだけの仲間になる癒やし系放置ゲームです。魚に名前を付け、水槽を自由に飾り、ほかのプレイヤーの作品と出会いながら、あなただけの海を育てましょう。

en.name: Creative Aquarium
en.description: What if your doodles could come to life on your desktop? Creative Aquarium is a relaxing idle desktop game where every fish you draw becomes a unique companion. Name your creations, decorate your tank, discover fish made by other players, and build an underwater world of your own.

games.name: 英雄变美
games.description: 『Glow up Hero』は、美しさが力になるカードローグライク。歴史や神話の英雄を仲間にし、最大4人で出撃。各英雄は通常カード3枚と、各戦闘で1回ずつ使える切り札2枚を持つ。毎ターンのエナジーは3。使わなかった手札はターン終了時に捨てられる。変美すると姿が変わり、すべての専用カードが強化される。登場する英雄には、それぞれ歴史や神話のルーツがある。

en.name: Glow up Hero
en.description: Glow up Hero: a card roguelike where beauty = power. Recruit real-world heroes, field 4. Each: 3 standard + 2 ultimate cards (once per battle). 3 energy/turn, unused cards discarded. Glow Up transforms & upgrades all cards. Real origins. Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

games.name: Trap Testers
games.description: 友達を始末したくなるときもあるよね。そんなときはここで！『Trap Testers』は、みんなで罠を仕掛けてからゴールを目指して競争する、カオスなマルチプレイ・デスラン。友達を妨害し、罠をかわし、自分の罠で自滅しないように！

en.name: Trap Testers
en.description: Sometimes you just want to kill your friends. Well, here's your chance! Trap Testers is a chaotic multiplayer deathrun where everyone places traps before racing to the finish. Sabotage your friends, dodge their traps, and try not to die to your own.

games.name: アクアリウムデイズ
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
games.description: 『アクアリウムデイズ』は、魚を飼って集める癒し系ゲームです。かわいい魚60種、外観117種類、水槽の背景18種類を収録しています。水槽は小さなウィンドウでデスクトップに置いておくことも、動く壁紙にすることもできます。

en.name: Aquarium Days
en.description: Aquarium Days is a cozy fish-collecting game with 60 adorable species, 117 appearances, and 18 aquarium scenes. Keep your aquarium in a small window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

games.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
games.shortName: THE CLOCK THE QUEEN AND THE DOOR ON THE
games.description: A first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles ( see main description for more ). No AI.

en.name: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
en.description: A first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles ( see main description for more ). No AI.

games.name: RIFTFALL
games.description: 地獄は閉じなかった。進化した。90年代の名作を受け継ぐ高速で残酷なレトロFPS。全20レベル、特殊射撃付きの重火器5種、60種以上の敵、個性豊かなボスアリーナ、AI分隊、恒久アップグレード、スカルキー、隠し要素、壮大なサウンドトラックを収録。

en.name: RIFTFALL
en.description: HELL DIDN'T CLOSE. IT EVOLVED. A fast, brutal retro indie FPS raised on the 90s classics: a 20-level campaign, 6 heavy weapons with alt-fires, 60+ enemy types, unique boss arenas, AI squadmates, permanent upgrades, skull keys, secrets and an epic soundtrack.

games.name: Witnesses
games.description: Witnesses is a detective visual novel in a grim noir style. You are a private detective assigned two strange cases.

en.name: Witnesses
en.description: Witnesses is a detective visual novel in a grim noir style. You are a private detective assigned two strange cases.

games.name: Cartoon Crime
games.description: Cartoon Crime は、ミッションを無視して好きに遊べるオープンワールド・クライムアクション。三人称視点と見下ろし視点をいつでも切り替え、車を走らせ、戦い、ボディガードを雇い、警察を振り切ろう。ソロでもオンライン協力プレイでも楽しめます。

en.name: Cartoon Crime
en.description: Cartoon Crime is an open-world crime sandbox where missions are optional and chaos is always one bad decision away. Switch instantly between third-person and top-down gameplay, drive, fight, recruit bodyguards, outrun the police, and explore the world alone or in online co-op.

games.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
games.description: AIデータセンターを経営する、手を動かして遊ぶインクリメンタルゲーム。飛び交うデータパケットをカーソルでなぞってお金に変え、サーバーラックやGPU、ドローンに投資しましょう。冷却と電力を保ちながら、ノートPC1台の会社をAGIへと成長させます。

trailers.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental Trailer
Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental - Announcement Trailer

en.name: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
en.description: An active incremental about running an AI data center. Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs, drones and more. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI.

games.name: DashBreaker
games.description: 小さな隕石を砕いていた機体で、巨大な戦艦まで貫こう。DashBreakerは、ダッシュで敵を破壊し、集めた資源で機体を恒久的に強化するアクティブ・インクリメンタルゲームです。新たな能力を解放し、より多くの敵を一度に一掃しましょう。

en.name: DashBreaker
en.description: From breaking asteroids to piercing massive warships, grow your small craft into a force to be reckoned with. DashBreaker is an active incremental game: dash through enemies, gather resources, and buy permanent upgrades. Unlock new abilities and wipe out more enemies with every dash.

games.name: Strategy Core
games.description: Lead your clan from a small settlement all the way to the launch of a colony ship. Gather resources, construct buildings, advance your technology, and defend against raids. Spanning seven eras, a procedurally generated world, and rival clans—in Strategy Core, your survival depends on your strategy.

en.name: Strategy Core

Spanning seven eras, a procedurally generated world, and rival clans—in Strategy Core, your survival depends on your strategy.

games.name: ALTEREDBLOOD+ [AB+]
games.description: A BLOOD-soaking Movement-FPS platformer🩸where you Splatter walls and floors with your foe’s BLOOD. Stand in that BLOOD to [ALTER] yourself and your Weapons. Soak up BLOOD to replenish and keep fighting. MOTHER created you to stop them. Beckon our Extinction.

games.name: WORKS: Motorsport Factory
games.description: 自宅のガレージからレーシングファクトリーを築く経営シミュレーション。中古部品を探し、購入し、ときには自ら設計。マシンを整備し、モータースポーツの頂点を目指そう。限られた資金と劣化する部品が、厳しい決断を迫る。修理か、アップグレードか。それとも借金を返してチームを存続させるか。

en.name: WORKS: Motorsport Factory
en.description: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive.

games.name: Piano Glow
genres: インストゥルメンタル
games.description: オンラインのマルチプレイロビーでピアノを演奏！ランキングや、聴音・楽譜・リズム・4K/7K・落下ノーツを使ったゲーム感覚のトレーニングも楽しめます。パソコンやノートPCのQWERTYキーボード、またはピアノで、どんな曲でも演奏可能。ピアノ動画や楽譜を落下ノーツのチュートリアルやMIDIに変換できます。

trailers.name: Works with QWERTY or piano! Multiplayer with AI tools to convert any piano video or sheet music into falling notes

en.name: Piano Glow
en.description: Piano in online multiplayer lobbies, with leaderboards, gamified training modes (ear, sheet, rhythm, 4K/7K and falling notes). Play any song using either a QWERTY computer/laptop keyboard or a piano. Convert any piano video or sheet music into falling notes tutorial/MIDI.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.shortName: GODZILLA: DESTROY ALL MONSTERS MELEE REM
games.description: ゴジラたちが激突する究極のアリーナ格闘ゲームが、フルリマスターで復活！好きな怪獣を選び、実在の都市を再現した街並みなどのステージで強烈な攻撃を繰り出そう。ローカル協力プレイや新登場のオンラインマルチプレイで、友達やライバルと激突！

trailers.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered - Launch Trailer

en.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
en.description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

games.name: Playrooms
games.description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

en.name: Playrooms
en.description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

games.name: Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road
genres: 一騎当千方式シューティング
games.description: Bad Fruits have taken over the Roads! Fight off waves of Fruits in this comedic chaotic side-scrolling shooter! Deliver Cargo, Upgrade your Ride, Hire Defenders, and choose the right Gear to protect your Caravan and survive the Road ahead!

trailers.name: Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road LAUNCH Trailer

en.name: Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road
en.description: Bad Fruits have taken over the Roads! Fight off waves of Fruits in this comedic chaotic side-scrolling shooter! Deliver Cargo, Upgrade your Ride, Hire Defenders, and choose the right Gear to protect your Caravan and survive the Road ahead!

games.name: 组长！怨念请查收！
games.description: 玩家将扮演一位刻薄的组长，从危险重重受到诅咒的公司里逃脱。在这里，不仅要躲避危险想办法完成10个“愿望”，还得小心那些针对你的、出乎意料的陷阱。

en.name: 组长！怨念请查收！
en.description: 玩家将扮演一位刻薄的组长，从危险重重受到诅咒的公司里逃脱。在这里，不仅要躲避危险想办法完成10个“愿望”，还得小心那些针对你的、出乎意料的陷阱。

games.name: 錬金帝国
games.description: 『錬金帝国』は、ポーション調合と店舗経営をテーマにしたカード式経営シミュレーションゲームです。魔法の原料を育て、不思議なポーションを醸造し、領主たちから舞い込む特大注文をさばきながら、事業をアップグレード＆拡大していきましょう！ さあ、腕まくりをして仕事に取り掛かる時間です。新任の工房長、国王のために偉大なるポーション帝国を築き上げましょう！

en.name: Stack & Brew
en.description: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

games.name: One More Floor
games.description: One More Floorは短編のインクリメンタルゲームです。エレベーターで鉱山へ降り、ターゲットを狙って各フロアでコインを倍増させ、力尽きる前に換金しましょう。新しい鉱山を解放し、レアな宝石を集めて、永続的なプレステージ強化を購入できます。

en.name: One More Floor
en.description: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

games.name: In Full Bloom
games.description: 小さな赤ちゃんに餌をあげて、育てよう。あらゆるものを貪り食べながら成長する姿を見守ろう。『イン・フル・ブルーム』は、『たまごっち』にインスパイアされた『塊魂』ライクなゲームだ。主人公は周囲の世界に対して底なしの食欲を持つクリーチャーだ。道はただ一つ。

en.name: In Full Bloom
en.description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for the world around it. There is only one way.

games.name: Killer Aces Volleyball
games.description: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest men's and women's teams in the world!

en.name: Killer Aces Volleyball
en.description: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest men's and women's teams in the world!

games.name: Unbroken: The Awakening
games.description: あなたは耐え抜き、勝利するでしょう。あなたの勇気があなたの最も強力な味方となります。

en.name: Unbroken: The Awakening
en.description: Brave the hostile lands in search of your goal. Forge your own path and discover the many secrets of the realm and the looming Township of Westfall. Unlock new abilities, perks and weapons. Soak in the atmosphere and head forth against all odds.

games.name: Message From Aliens
games.description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

en.name: Message From Aliens
en.description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

games.name: Underkeep
games.description: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear, and explore a fully handcrafted world.

en.name: Underkeep
en.description: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear, and explore a fully handcrafted world.

games.name: Wielders of the Essence
games.description: インクレメンタル型ベースビルドの要素を含む一人用ホード・サバイバル。1回のプレイ時間は8分、ゲームクリアまでの所要時間は8時間ほどです。

en.name: Wielders of the Essence
en.description: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Cast spells, command troops, and take your town from puddle to paradise. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

games.name: Pogo Together
genres: 精密プラットフォーム
games.description: 一緒に跳んで、落ちて、キレて、登ろう。『Pogo Together』は、ムキムキすぎる動物たちがポゴスティックで過酷な障害物へ挑む、1～4人用の物理演算ベース精密プラットフォーマー。助け合うもよし、蹴り落とすもよし。もちろん一人でも遊べます。

en.name: Pogo Together
en.description: Bounce, fall, rage, and climb together. Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based precision platformer where ridiculously jacked animals attempt to conquer brutal obstacles on pogo sticks. Help each other, kick each other off, or take on the climb alone.

games.name: ロードラッシュ™: 30th Anniversary Edition
games.shortName: ロードラッシュ: 30TH ANNIVERSARY EDITION
games.description: コンバットレーシングというジャンルを確立した「Road Rash」が、初のデジタル版として帰ってきました。この30th Anniversary Editionには、完全再ライセンス版サウンドトラック、高解像度シネマティクス、最大60FPSのゲームプレイなどが含まれています。

en.name: Road Rash™: 30th Anniversary Edition
en.description: Road Rash, the franchise which defined the combat racing genre, returns in the first ever digital version of the game. This 30th Anniversary Edition includes a fully relicensed soundtrack, higher resolution cinematics, up to 60 FPS gameplay, and more.

games.name: BOOST VECTOR EX
games.description: 誰よりも速く走れ。「ベクターマスター」を操り、過酷なコースを駆け抜けろ。リアルパルクールレース。自分のスタイルを磨き、力強く素早い操作で最強を目指しましょう。ベクターワールドカップでチャンピオンを目指せ。君の速さは十分か？

en.name: BOOST VECTOR EX
en.description: RUN FAST. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

games.name: Deadzoned
games.description: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!

en.name: Deadzoned
en.description: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!

games.name: リーナのお掃除物語
games.description: ゴミを片付け、ホコリを拭き取り、散らかったお部屋を少しずつきれいにしていく——『リーナのお掃除物語』は、心安らぐカジュアルなお掃除シミュレーションゲームです！部屋を整える中で、写真や手紙、忘れ去られた小物など、さまざまな生活の品々に出会います。散らばった思い出から、それぞれの部屋に秘められた物語を少しずつ紐解いていきましょう。自由にお片付けして、好きな場所に飾り、整える心地よさを楽しんでください！

en.name: Clean Start
en.description: Clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering emotional stories through the objects you find. Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.

games.name: Cheater's Table
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
games.description: 正々堂々と遊べ。真っ先に死ね。Cheater’s Table は、イカサマが核となる 3D オンラインのソーシャルディダクション系カードゲーム。ブラフをかけ、罠を仕掛け、リスクを吊り上げて、テーブルの主導権を奪え。

en.name: Cheater's Table
en.description: At this table, cheating is the game. Hide your power cards up your sleeve or down your pant leg, then strike when the time is right. But stay sharp - a scratch isn't always a cheat. This table is full of traps...

games.name: ASTERIS
games.description: 数千通りのビルドとMMO式の成長を楽しむ、1〜4人協力アクションローグライト。仲間との相乗効果とスキルに隠れた連携を発見し、神の姿で戦局を覆そう。冒険が終わっても装備と成長は残ります。

trailers.name: Gameplay Overview - Heroes, Runes and Gods

en.name: ASTERIS
en.description: Explore thousands of builds and MMO-style progression in a 1–4 player action roguelite. Discover party synergies and hidden skill interactions, take a god's form, and keep your gear and growth after each run.

games.name: Pionero Capital
games.description: From one-person online store to e-commerce giant - pack, drive and deliver orders across the open world of Pionero Island. Grow with employees, vehicles, properties and new businesses until the company runs without you. Solo or co-op

en.name: Pionero Capital
en.description: From one-person online store to e-commerce giant - pack, drive and deliver orders across the open world of Pionero Island. Grow with employees, vehicles, properties and new businesses until the company runs without you. Solo or co-op

games.name: Voxotron
genres: 乗り物シミュレーション
games.description: サイケでハイパースピードのレーシングゲーム。速度制限もブレーキもなし。避けて、ニアミスして、爆走せよ。回りつづける宇宙の円柱型コースでは、レースは1回30秒、死は一瞬だ。世界記録を求め、リプレイできるゴーストを追いかけ、最大8人でプレイせよ。

en.name: Voxotron
en.description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

games.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
games.description: 自分だけのワイナリーを築き、卓越したワインを造り、収穫のたびに評判を高めていきましょう。レシピを解禁し、新技術を習得し、四季を乗り越える——優れたワイン造りとは芸術であり、一本一本のボトルがそれぞれの物語を語るのですから。

en.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
en.description: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.

games.name: Warlapse
games.description: 戦争は英雄的行為ではなく、冷酷な秩序と機動の技術だ。石器時代から現代まで続く7つの時代で、敵を包囲し、補給を断ち、士気を崩壊させてkillboxで殲滅せよ。Campaignで古参兵を率い、素早いSkirmishに挑み、あるいは自分だけのユニットをデザインしてMODで未来の戦争を作り出せ!

en.name: Warlapse
en.description: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

games.name: Snow Resort Simulator
games.description: 山奥のチケット売り場ひとつから始めよう。雪かき、薪割り、屋根の氷砕き、すべて自分の手で、すべて一人称視点で。ドリンクを出し、料理を作り、スキー用品を修理して、寂れた山小屋をホテル、レストラン、バー、ショップを備えた本格リゾートに変えよう。

en.name: Snow Resort Simulator
en.description: Start with nothing but a ticket booth in the mountains. Clear snow, chop wood, crack ice off rooftops, all by hand, all in first person. Serve drinks, cook meals, repair ski gear, and turn a rundown mountain stop into a full-blown resort with a hotel, restaurant, bar, and shop.

games.name: Lost Host
genres: パズルプラットフォーム
games.description: おもちゃの車はゲームの主人公になれるのか？ ある夜、持ち主の少年は跡形もなく謎の失踪を遂げた。 静かな部屋に取り残された小さな車は、少年を見つけるために、不気味で胸に迫る旅へと走り出す――

en.name: Lost Host
en.description: Can a toy car become the hero of a video game? One night, its owner mysteriously vanished without a trace. Left alone in the quiet room, this little car sets out on a spooky and mysterious journey - to find the boy...

games.name: Kick
games.description: 『Kick』は、学校へ向かう懐かしい道のりを描いた物語。さまざまなユニークなチャレンジが詰まったステージでサッカースキルを磨こう。あなたはKickを極められるか？

en.name: Kick
