en.description: Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it?

games.name: DJ Life Simulator: 本物のDJスキルを学ぼう
games.shortName: DJ LIFE SIMULATOR: 本物のDJスキルを学ぼう
games.description: USB DJコントローラーやマウスとキーボードで、本物のDJスキルを身につけよう。26のレッスンでビートマッチ、EQ、エフェクトをマスターし、観客がすべてのミックスに反応する中、ホームパーティーからフェスのステージへ。

en.name: DJ Life Simulator: Learn to DJ for Real
en.description: Learn to DJ for real with a USB DJ controller or mouse and keyboard. Master beatmatching, EQ and effects in 26 interactive lessons, then rise from house parties to festival stages while a living crowd reacts to every mix you play.

games.name: How Empires Work: Incremental Strategy
games.description: An incremental grand strategy game about building the machinery of empire. Tax, trade, conquer, and civilise subjects and foreigners alike. Automate it all into institutions that run themselves across centuries of history. Her Imperial Majesty expects results.

trailers.name: Third Annual Symposium on How Empires Work

en.name: How Empires Work
en.description: An incremental grand strategy game about building the machinery of empire. Tax, trade, conquer, and civilise subjects and foreigners alike. Automate it all into institutions that run themselves across centuries of history. Her Imperial Majesty expects results.

games.name: エスケープ・アカデミー2：バック・トゥ・スクール
games.shortName: エスケープ・アカデミー2：バック・トゥ・スクール
games.description: 『エスケープ・アカデミー2：バック・トゥ・スクール』で授業再開！新たなキャンパスを探索して、死と隣り合わせのパズルルームから脱出、学園の創立当時から存在する陰謀を解き明かそう—チャイムが鳴る前に。ソロでプレイするもよし、友だちを誘ってオンラインやローカル協力プレイをするのもいいだろう。

trailers.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School Launch Trailer
Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
en.description: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

games.name: 降臨の地
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 唯一無二のデッキを構築し、シンプルな操作で怒涛のチェインを巻き起こし、桁外れの数字が跳ね上がる爽快感を味わいたいなら—— 『降臨之地』がまさにあなたの求めるゲームです。 使徒が降臨した絶望の世界で、300種以上のカードとレリックを自在に組み合わせ、病みつきになる爆発的なシナジーを解き放とう。

en.name: Realm of Advent
en.description: If you love building unique decks, triggering insane combos with simple controls, and watching numbers skyrocket—you'll love Realm of Advent. In a world ruled by Apostles, craft your build from 300+ cards and relics to ignite addictively wild chain reactions.

games.name: Crown & Coin: The Hundred Years（百年戦争）
games.shortName: CROWN & COIN: THE HUNDRED YEARS（百年戦争）
genres: 人生シミュレーション
games.description: 百年戦争を生き抜く、圧倒的自由度の太閤ライク。ジャンヌ・ダルクから偽物のデザルモワーズまで、全1015人の実在人物でプレイ可能。騎士として名を刻むか、新国家を樹立し英仏を滅ぼすか、商人や野盗として乱世を貪るかはあなた次第。史実イベントはもちろん、マルチエンディングは22枚のタロットカードに対応するコレクション要素も。剣と金貨で、あなただけの歴史を紡ぎ出せ！

en.name: Crown & Coin: The Hundred Years
en.description: Survive the Hundred Years' War in this medieval ensemble sandbox. Play as 1,015 historical figures, from Joan of Arc to the imposter des Armoises. Gain glory as a knight, forge a new kingdom to crush England and France, or thrive as a bandit. Discover 22 tarot-based multiple endings!

games.name: Old Money – Build Your Dynasty
genres: 人生シミュレーション
games.description: You're 18 with €2,500. Work your way up, trade stocks and crypto, buy property, build companies, run for office. Then your life ends, and your heir gets what the taxman leaves. One life is short. How long can your dynasty last?

en.name: Old Money – Build Your Dynasty
en.description: Old Money is an elegant business & life simulation: start from almost nothing, build business empires, play the markets, amass real estate, found a dynasty and rise all the way into politics. A whole life – your decisions, right down to the legacy you pass on.

games.name: Wheel Make It
games.description: 1台の車椅子。2人のプレイヤー。無限大のカオス。チームワーク、ドタバタ、無敵の友情パワーを描くソロおよび協力プレイ対応の物理演算ゲーム。

en.name: Wheel Make It
en.description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

games.name: 가문의 영광
games.description: A single-player idle RPG with classic K-MMORPG spirit and no paid gacha. Switch between nostalgic and painted visuals, hunt manually or automatically, and grow through loot, crafting, equipment enhancement, and family progression.

trailers.name: 가문의 영광 · 직접 만들고 싶은 세계 | A Game I Wanted to Play
변신 뽑기 · 새로운 모습의 계약 | Transformation Contracts
인형 뽑기 · 끝까지 달려라! | Doll Companion Race

en.name: 가문의 영광
en.description: A single-player idle RPG with classic K-MMORPG spirit and no paid gacha. Switch between nostalgic and painted visuals, hunt manually or automatically, and grow through loot, crafting, equipment enhancement, and family progression.

games.name: Bibidi Bibidi!
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: Bibidi Bibidi! is a whimsical deckbuilder where your wizard shouts whatever spell you conjure up. Every card has 3 components that you combine in your spellbook for unique effects. Mix and match incantations like sim-sala-bim and abra-kadabra to zap your way through a dungeon filled with monsters.

en.name: Bibidi Bibidi!
en.description: Bibidi Bibidi! is a whimsical deckbuilder where your wizard shouts whatever spell you conjure up. Every card has 3 components that you combine in your spellbook for unique effects. Mix and match incantations like sim-sala-bim and abra-kadabra to zap your way through a dungeon filled with monsters.

games.name: Theme Hospital™
games.description: ハイテク病院施設を設計、維持、管理し、限られた資源を最大限に活用し、治療を現金に変えましょう。収支のやりくりと便器の世話、両方こなせますか？

en.name: Theme Hospital™
en.description: Design, maintain and manage a hi-tech hospital facility, making the most of limited resources and turning cures into cash. Can you balance the books and the bedpans?

games.name: HAVKER-MAN X
genres: 没入シミュレーション
games.description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

en.name: HAVKER-MAN X
en.description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

games.name: ニャンびり釣り日和
genres: デスクトップコンパニオン
games.description: ほっこり癒やし系の放置型釣りゲームです。PCデスクトップの片隅でのんびり釣りを楽しみ、可愛いアバターや背景を自由にカスタマイズ。様々な種類の猫たちに餌をあげてコレクションしましょう。美しい新しいシナリオを徐々にアンロックして、お仕事や勉強の合間をもっと楽しく。マルチプレイ対応で、みんなでこっそり“サボりタイム”を！

en.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
en.description: Dive into a cozy, idle fishing experience! Cast your line from a little corner on your desktop. Customize your cute avatar and background, then feed and collect adorable cats of all breeds. Unlock beautiful scenes and jump into multiplayer and sneak in some "chill-time" with friends!

games.name: ラッキーパンク：運試しデッキ構築ゲーム
games.shortName: ラッキーパンク：運試しデッキ構築ゲーム
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
games.description: 運を天に任せ、確率をぶち破るローグライク・デッキビルダー。*もう1枚引く*か、*止める*か。確率1％、選択100％。極彩色のエコ・ディストピアで生き延びて成り上がれ…それとも脱落するか？ ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ 終末後の世界で物資をかき集め、コミュニティを育てろ。運を試す覚悟はあるか、パンク？💀

en.name: Lucky Punk: a push your luck Deckbuilder
en.description: Push your luck and beat the odds in this roguelike deckbuilder that always shows your chances of failing. How much are you willing to risk? Survive and thrive in a vibrant eco-dystopia … or don’t. ¯_(ツ)_/¯ Gather supplies and grow your community in the post-apocalypse. Do you feel lucky, Punk? 💀

games.name: MMO Simulator: ASCENSIONS
games.description: Experience the thrills and clicks of a Massively Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game without the needless fluff in this idle/incremental game that captures the endless grind of an MMO while boiling the game systems down to their absolute barebones.

en.name: MMO Simulator: ASCENSIONS
en.description: Experience the thrills and clicks of a Massively Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game without the needless fluff in this idle/incremental game that captures the endless grind of an MMO while boiling the game systems down to their absolute barebones.

games.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
games.description: 沼る爽快アーケード×インクリメンタル。マウスでブラックホールを操り、カラフルなキューブを根こそぎ吸い込め！XPでラン中に巨大化、コインは永続強化にぶち込め。魔導書の磁力・複製・キューブの雨で、画面はカラフルな大混乱。時間切れ？あと1回だけ！

en.name: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
en.description: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

games.name: ボクボク
games.description: 『ボクボク』は、癒し系建築箱庭ゲームです。家を建てたり、自分だけの世界を創造したり、新しい友達を作ったりできます。不思議な世界を探検し、このピクセルでできた楽園にあなたの足跡を残しましょう。

en.name: Boku Boku
en.description: Boku Boku is a Cozy Building sandbox game. You can build houses, create your own worlds, and make new friends. Explore a wondrous world, and leave your mark in this pixel paradise.

games.name: marblebuilds
games.description: A creative marble physics sandbox. Place blocks on an infinite grid to build anything you can imagine: marble runs, functional calculators, precision platformer courses, playable minigames, pinball machines, automated music tracks, and more.

en.name: marblebuilds
en.description: A creative marble physics sandbox. Place blocks on an infinite grid to build anything you can imagine: marble runs, functional calculators, precision platformer courses, playable minigames, pinball machines, automated music tracks, and more.

games.name: 病能探偵
games.description: 認知異常により歪められた殺人現場で真実を探れ。『病能探偵』は、認知異常×本格ミステリーのデスゲーム推理アドベンチャー。 嘘がつけない、左半分が見えない、顔が識別できない—— 異常なルールを乗り越え、真犯人を暴き出せ。

en.name: Psycho-Sleuth
en.description: Psycho-Sleuth is a mystery game where cognitive disorders distort the rules of murder. Enter the minds of 13 afflicted players trapped in a deadly game, each with an abnormal mental condition. These disorders are contagious, but the killer hides amongst twisted logic.

games.name: Feed The Forest
games.description: カタツムリパワーで砂漠を緑の森へと育て、究極レベルまで利益の最大化を目指すアクティブインクリメンタルゲーム。植物を最適な配置にして、複数の資源の生産を自動化。ミニオンを雇い、不徳な植物を解放して罪深き大金持ちを目指そう。そして忘れるな：血もエキスの一種だ。

en.name: Feed The Forest
en.description: Use snail powers to grow a desert into a lush forest, and then profit-maximize it to insanity in this active incremental game. Optimize plant layouts to automate production of multiple resources. Hire minions, unlock immoral plants, get ungodly rich, and remember: Blood is a type of juice.

games.name: Phantom Grind
games.description: Phantom Grindは、マウスだけで遊べるミニマルなアクションRPGです。モンスターを倒し、4つの能力値を強化して、騎士をレベル30まで育て、古代の邪悪に挑みましょう。

en.name: Phantom Grind
en.description: Phantom Grind is a minimalist pixel-art action RPG you can play entirely with a mouse. Click to fight monsters, earn XP and gold, upgrade four stats, and reach Level 30 to face the final boss.

games.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
genres: キャラクターカスタマイズ
games.description: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and improve your character.

en.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
en.description: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and improve your character.

games.name: Slots & Skulls
games.description: スロットマシンで戦うターン制roguelite。マシンを止めて攻撃し、戦いに勝って宝箱を手に入れ、落ちた品を金床で強化しろ（度胸があるなら）。あるいは友達を招待して、その友達と戦え。

en.name: Slots & Skulls
en.description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Stop the machine to attack, win fights for chests, and upgrade what drops at the forge (if you dare). Or invite a friend and fight them.

games.name: Swarmslam
games.description: 無数の小さなスラマーが群れをなして惑星に襲いかかり、砕けるまで採掘する。手に入れた鉱石をヴォイドに捧げれば、スウォームはさらに大きく、速くなる。スラムしろ、砕け、くり返せ。

trailers.name: Swarmslam Official Release Date Announcement Trailer

en.name: Swarmslam
en.description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

games.name: Soulstack
games.description: カードを重ねて遊ぶRPG。素材を集め、武器を鍛え、ダンジョンを戦い抜こう。あなたとペット、それぞれの進化の道を選べる：48のクラス（うち9つは呪われている）、140のペット形態。武器は300種以上、棒に石をくくりつけただけのものから手持ちバリスタまで。それでもまるで管理ツールが命を持ったかのよう。

en.name: Soulstack
en.description: Card-stacking RPG: gather, forge weapons and fight through dungeons. Pick an evolution path for both you and your pet: 48 classes (9 cursed), 140 pet forms. 300+ weapons, from a stone on a stick to a hand-held ballista. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

games.name: Sort My Comics !
games.description: コミックがそこら中に散らばっている。コレクションを整理するのはあなたの役目！仕分けて、棚に並べ、シリーズを完成させ、能力をアンロックして、この巨大な混沌を少しずつ心地よく穏やかな空間へと変えていこう。

en.name: Sort My Comics !
en.description: Comics everywhere. It’s up to you to bring order back to the collection! Sort, shelve, complete your series, and unlock powers that gradually turn this gigantic mess into something wonderfully calming.

games.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
games.shortName: LIVIN' THE CREAM: ICE CREAM SIMULATOR
genres: 没入シミュレーション
games.description: カリブ海の活気ある舞台で自分だけのアイスクリームショップを経営しよう。アイスを作り、フレーバーを混ぜ、トッピングを加え、客を接客し、店を清潔に保ち、材料を補充し、スタッフを雇い、小さなスタンドから賑やかなビジネスへと成長させよう。

en.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
en.description: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting! Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.

games.name: 楽園の採掘師
games.description: 衣装を見つけて、天使と恋をして、ハーレムを作りましょう！楽園の採掘師でリラックスした旅を始めて、ユニークなハーレムを作りましょう。

en.name: Heaven Miner
en.description: Find outfits, fall in love with angels, and build a harem! Start a relaxing journey in Heaven Miner and build a unique harem.

games.name: Leviathan: Rhino
games.description: 巨大なリヴァイアサンが迫り来る小さな村で、老人 Petro の最後の日々を体験してください。避けられない運命、孤独、そして行く場所も去る理由もない一人の男を描く、実存的ホラーゲームです。

en.name: Leviathan: Rhino
en.description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

games.name: 盤上三国志
games.description: 漢王朝は衰え、群雄が割拠する。かつての天下は崩れた盤面のごとく乱れ、もはや定まった趨勢など存在しない。 天下を盤とし、民を駒とする。あなたは烽火渦巻く三国乱世へと足を踏み入れ、兵を率い、陣を敷き、策を巡らせて一手を打つ。群雄ひしめく戦場で敵を破り、城を奪い、天下を目指せ！

en.name: Chess: Three Kingdom
en.description: The Han dynasty is fading, and warlords rise. The realm has shattered like a broken chessboard, with no end in sight. The land is your board, its soilder your pieces. Enter the chaos of the Three Kingdoms, command armies, outwit rivals, seize cities, and fight for dominion!

games.name: Storage Anomaly
games.description: 『Storage Anomaly』では、店の倉庫に潜む異変を見つけ出すレジ係となります。注意深く観察し、スマートフォンで異変を撮影し、謎を解きながら、薄暗く不気味な環境で予期せぬ困難に立ち向かいましょう。

en.name: Storage Anomaly
en.description: Storage Anomaly puts you in the role of a cashier assigned to identify unusual anomalies in a store's storage room. Use your phone to take photos of the anomalies, stay alert, solve puzzles, and face unexpected challenges as you navigate through a dark and creepy environment

games.name: Deal Flipper
games.description: 安く買い、高く売る。内に秘めた「なにわの商人魂」を呼び覚ませ！『Deal Flipper』は、フリマアプリを漁り、リアルタイムチャットでエグい値引き交渉を仕掛け、利益を貪る一人称せどりシミュレーター。一筋縄ではいかない売り手たちの心理を読み、出し抜き、せどり帝国を築き上げろ…圧倒的利益を出せるかは、あんたの腕次第！

en.name: Deal Flipper
en.description: Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal. Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where you scour an online marketplace, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell for profit. Every trader plays differently. Read them, outdeal them, and build your empire.

games.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
games.description: 邪神に脳みそを捧げる、おバカな一人称視点の放置・育成ゲーム。 脳みそを拾って投げ、自動化しよう。変異を解放し、忠実な信者を集め、神殿を究極の脳みそ供給マシンへと作り変えろ。

en.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
en.description: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

games.name: Diskette Dungeon
genres: ハックアンドスラッシュ
games.description: 魔法のディスケットがあなたのオフィスにポータルを開き、あなたを無限のダンジョンに引き込みます。そこで生き残れるかどうかは、順応し、戦い、次の世界のロックを解除するために破損したデータを収集するかどうかにかかっています。さまざまな力と武器があり、実行するたびに異なる挑戦が待っています。

en.name: Diskette Dungeon
en.description: A magical Diskette opens a portal in your office, pulling you into endless dungeons where survival depends on adapting, fighting, and collecting corrupted data to unlock the next world. With a wide variety of powers and weapons, every run offers a different challenge.

games.name: Saloon Simulator
games.description: 酒場を経営して、ワイルドウェストで自分の場所を切り開こう。バーを整え、助っ人を雇い、カウンターに集まる人々の生活や悩みに関わろう。ここでは、正直な商売だけでは足りない。フロンティアで生き抜く方法を確かめろ。

en.name: Saloon Simulator
en.description: Start by running a saloon and carve your own place in the Wild West. Shape your bar, hire help, and get drawn into the lives and troubles of the people who gather around your counter. Out here, honest business is rarely enough. See what it takes to survive the frontier.

games.name: GRAVHOUNDS
genres: サードパーソンシューティング
games.description: 『GRAVHOUNDS』は、1～4人で遊べる協力アクションビルダーゲーム。仲間と共に危険な惑星に降り立ち、物理演算に基づく大混乱の中で基地を建設・防衛し、エイリアンの餌食になる前に、できるだけたくさんの物資をかき集めて脱出せよ！ 滞在時間が長くなるほど、危険も増す… だが報酬も豪華になるぞ。

en.name: GRAVHOUNDS
en.description: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

games.name: Soviet Backrooms
games.description: Soviet Backroomsは、廃墟と化したソ連時代の集合住宅を舞台にした一人称視点のサバイバルホラー。荒れ果てた部屋や階段、果てしない廊下を探索して出口を探し、姿の見えない何者かの足音に耳を澄ませよう。

en.name: Soviet Backrooms
en.description: Soviet Backrooms is a first-person survival horror set in abandoned Soviet apartment blocks. Explore decaying apartments, stairwells, and endless corridors, search for a way out, and listen for the footsteps of something you cannot see.

games.name: 修羅の殺陣
games.description: 『修羅の殺陣』は、和風スタイルの高速アクション・ハックアンドスラッシュのプラットフォーマーです。プレイヤーは半人半狐の「狐忍び」となり、失踪した姉を探す復讐の旅に出ます。ゲームは素早く激しい戦闘テンポを強調しており、プレイヤーの反応と戦略が試されます。激しい戦いの中で修羅となり、道を阻むすべてを斬り伏せましょう！

en.name: HEART ABYSS
en.description: Heart Abyss is a brutal action-platformer inspired by Japan during the 17th and 18th centuries. Wake up your inner beast and take vengeance on those who put a collar around your neck. Find your sister and uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of all jinkos.

games.name: Ramen Shop Simulator
games.description: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique shop.

en.name: Ramen Shop Simulator
en.description: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique shop.

games.name: 童話の掃除屋
games.description: 『童話の掃除屋』は、放置・育成（インクリメンタル）要素とライトなハクスラ（ハックアンドスラッシュ）が融合した爽快アクション冒険ゲームです。核心となるゲームプレイは至ってシンプル。押し寄せるモンスターをなぎ倒し、クエストをクリアして、大量のゴールドや素材をハック＆スラッシュ！手に入れた戦利品で膨大なスキルツリーを解放し、強力な武器を鍛造し、ポーションを買い込んで、次なる冒険へ繰り出そう！

en.name: Tale Sweeper
en.description: Tale Sweeper blends incremental progression with light loot mechanics. Hack and slash monsters, complete quests, and gather gold and materials. Use your loot to upgrade a massive skill tree, craft powerful weapons, and buy potions to gear up for your next adventure!

games.name: Card Collection Simulator
games.description: Rip packs live while your chat goes wild. Hustle at the con, chase perfect Grade 10s, and show off your best pulls in your own trophy room. Can you collect them all?

en.name: Card Collection Simulator
en.description: Rip packs live while your chat goes wild. Hustle at the con, chase perfect Grade 10s, and show off your best pulls in your own trophy room. Can you collect them all?

games.name: 蓬莱の雪
games.description: 『蓬莱の雪』は、中国古代を舞台にした百合ビジュアルノベルです。プレイヤーは人形・璇花の視点を通して、巫女・祝寒川の全てと向き合います。 それは、血の中から蓮の花が再び咲く、再生の物語でもある。

en.name: Snow of Penglai
en.description: Snow of Penglai is a yuri-themed visual novel set in ancient China. Players will step into the shoes of Xuanhua, a puppet girl, and confront everything about the witch Zhu Hanchuan. This is a story of rebirth. A lotus rising, bleeding, blooming anew.

games.name: Potato Please
games.description: 一人称視点のジャガイモ皮むきゲーム。ナイフがある。バケツがある。ジャガイモの山がある。本物の物理演算で皮をむこう。薄く切って、無駄にしない。もっと良い道具を買おう。山がなくなるまでむき続けろ。君ほど上手くむける者はいない。

en.name: Potato Please
en.description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

games.name: Incremental Traffic
games.description: 渋滞こそが最大の敵になる交通・物流ゲーム。畑や森、採石場から、自動生成された町を抜けて品物を運ぼう。配達するたびにお金が入り、トラックを買い足していくと、やがて自分のトラックで道路が大渋滞。そうなったら、交通ルールで流れを取り戻そう。

en.name: Incremental Traffic
en.description: An incremental logistics game where traffic becomes a challenge. Haul goods from fields, forests and quarries through a procedurally generated town, earn money with every delivery and buy more trucks, until your own fleet jams the streets. Then fix it with traffic rules.

games.name: Moonshiner Simulator
games.description: これは、アルコール飲料製造を深くシミュレートするゲームです。ゼロからスタートし、職人の技を極め、独自のレシピを生み出すことで、あなたの事業を繁栄する帝国へと変えましょう。しかし、忘れてはいけません。あなたの邪魔をしたがる者たちは、常に現れるということを。

en.name: Moonshiner Simulator
en.description: Moonshiner Simulator is an in-depth spirits production simulator. Start from the bottom and build your operation into a thriving empire by mastering the intricacies of the craft and creating unique recipes. But beware – there will always be those who want to see you fail.

games.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
games.description: ドラゴンの宝の山が手に負えないことになっています。ゆったり構えて、金貨の山を一枚ずつ掃きあつめ、宝箱を次々に満たし、埋もれていた宝物を棚のあるべき場所へ。散らかりが少しずつ片づいていく様子をお楽しみください。心やすらぐお片づけゲーム。猫もいます。

en.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
en.description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

games.name: Mayday: The Survival Island
genres: オープンワールドサバイバルクラフト
games.description: 謎の島で目覚め、狩りや農業、クラフトで生き残れ。広大な群島を探検し、秘密を暴き、拠点を築こう。そして脱出できるか…挑め。

en.name: Mayday: The Survival Island
en.description: After a mysterious crash, you awaken alone on a strange island. Survive by hunting, farming, and crafting, then explore a vast archipelago filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and magical totems. Build your base, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.

games.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator
genres: 人生シミュレーション
games.description: ゼロから始めて、太陽輝くマイアミビーチで自分だけのビジネス帝国を築こう！レモネードを売り、自動販売機を運営し、事業を自動化して、ちょっとした副業を大きな利益に変えよう。のんびり楽しめる一人称シミュレーターだ。

en.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator
en.description: Start with nothing and build your own business empire in sunny Miami Beach! Sell lemonade, run vending machines, automate your companies and turn small side jobs into big profits in this relaxed first-person simulator.

games.name: Mycelarium
games.description: このリラックスできるインクリメンタル探索ゲームで、果てしなく広がる菌類のネットワークを育てよう。隠された資源を発見し、生産を自動化するキノコを栽培し、あなたの菌糸体を自立した地下帝国へと進化させよう。

en.name: Mycelarium
en.description: Grow an ever-expanding fungal network in this relaxing incremental exploration game. Discover hidden resources, cultivate mushrooms that automate your production, and evolve your mycelium into a self-sustaining underground empire.

games.name: Dungeons & Dynasties
games.description: 『Football Manager』×D&D。英雄は死に、王朝は興る。領域はその両方を記憶する。すべての対戦がダンジョンとなる生きた世界で冒険者ギルドを率いよう。英雄は誰もが死に得る。そして、すべてのシーズンが歴史として記される。

en.name: Dungeons & Dynasties
en.description: DnD meets Football Manager. Create a guild, watch them form relationships and grow old together. Lose people both to the dark and to rival guilds battling to be the best in the realm. Grow your own town, or vote to help build an existing one. Or take the Cozy approach and run a guild on your terms.

games.name: Beat For Speed
games.description: どんな曲も、リズムに乗って走れるコースに！お気に入りの音楽をインポートするか、ライブオーディオモードでPCから流れる音に合わせてプレイ。インディーアーティストの公式楽曲を楽しみ、ランキングに挑戦し、レベルエディターでカスタムレベルを作成して、Steamワークショップでコミュニティのレベルを探そう。

en.name: Beat For Speed
en.description: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.

games.name: 紅塵仙途：師兄が強すぎる
games.shortName: 紅塵仙途：師兄が強すぎる
games.description: バックパックライク×戦略×弾幕シューティングの仙侠ローグライク。ランダム法宝、限られたマス、合成と進化で最強ビルドを構築。紅顔の師妹と出会い、道身を強化し、最後の浄土を守れ。気軽に遊べて、やめられない！

en.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
en.description: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!

games.name: Dead Sector
games.description: あなただけのデータセンターを運営しよう。サーバーボードをコンポーネント単位で設計し、限られたボード上のスペースを賢く使い切れ。フロア全体に電源とネットワークを張り巡らせて専門特化クラスターを構築し、自作ハードウェアに契約を割り当てよう。一台のラックから、巨大で冗長化されたマルチクラスター運用へとスケールさせていこう。

en.name: Dead Sector
en.description: Run your own data center. Design server boards component by component and use your boards space wisely. Wire power and network throughout your floor to form specialized clusters, and dispatch contracts to your custom hardware. Scale from a single rack to a massive redundant, multi-cluster operation.

games.name: Civitas: World Simulator
games.description: Civitas: World Simulator is a deep historical-fantasy simulation where nations will dynamically rise, fall, and evolve. In this game we model internal forces like ethnicity, culture, language and other inner political struggles.

en.name: Civitas: World Simulator
en.description: Civitas: World Simulator is a deep historical-fantasy simulation where nations will dynamically rise, fall, and evolve. In this game we model internal forces like ethnicity, culture, language and other inner political struggles.

games.name: Golf 5 MAX
games.description: レトロなアーケードゴルフとリアルな物理演算が融合。自分だけのゴルファーを育て、スイングを極め、各ホールがすべてを懸けた勝負となる Birdie or Bust に挑もう。ソロで楽しむもよし、世界中のライバルに挑むもよし。発売記念セール実施中、今なら25%オフ！

en.name: Golf 5 MAX
en.description: Launching November 2 on Steam! Retro arcade golf meets real physics. Build your golfer, master your swing and take on Birdie or Bust, where every hole is all or nothing. Play solo or challenge rivals worldwide. Try the free demo now!

games.name: Sabado
games.description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

en.name: Sabado
en.description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

games.name: 中古ゲームショップ シミュレーター
games.shortName: 中古ゲームショップ シミュレーター
genres: 職業シミュレーション
games.description: ゼロから中古ゲーム業界の頂点へ！大作からインディー作品まで揃う店を築け。目利きでレア品を見抜き、売買と交渉で利益を伸ばす。買い取り・価格設定・販売はすべてあなたの判断次第。小さな露店から伝説の店長へ、あなたの物語がここから始まる。

en.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
en.description: Run a 2000s second-hand game store! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make a profit and upgrade your shop! Repair customers' consoles, clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular games with the highest replay value!

games.name: PIX Football Manager
games.description: オンラインのサッカー監督ゲーム。350以上のクラブから才能を発掘し、自分の目を信じて最適な選手を見つけ、オークションでライバル監督に競り勝とう。チームの連携を高め、戦術を練り、週ごとのリーグで他の監督のクラブと対戦。自分のペースで楽しめます。

en.name: PIX Football Manager
en.description: An online football manager. Scout talent from 350+ clubs, trust your eye to find the right players, and outbid rival managers in auctions. Build squad chemistry, shape your tactics, and face other managers’ clubs in weekly leagues, on your own schedule.

games.name: Studs Up!
games.description: First-person football where you control your feet, with no scripted animations deciding where the ball goes. Play 1v1 to 5v5 online as a striker, keeper or referee. Have no friends? Draft a squad in the 'Cup Run' roguelite mode. Level up your players, pick upgrades and fight through a knockout cup.

en.name: Studs Up!
en.description: First-person football where you control your feet, with no scripted animations deciding where the ball goes. Play 1v1 to 5v5 online as a striker, keeper or referee. Have no friends? Draft a squad in the 'Cup Run' roguelite mode. Level up your players, pick upgrades and fight through a knockout cup.

games.name: PIT OF GOBLIN
games.description: このオンラインホラーCo-opで、ケンカっ早いゴブリンとなって、ダンジョンを探索し、罠を回避し、モンスターから逃げ、ゴブリンのキングクイーンに食事を提供しよう。ゴブリン仲間とチームを組むもよし、一匹ゴブリンで行くもよし。ピットの深部へ潜り、混乱を引き起こせ！ 食事提供に失敗すれば、次に食べられるのは君かもしれない！

en.name: PIT OF GOBLIN
en.description: In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King-Queen. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed them, and you might be the next meal!

games.name: Loftia
genres: 人生シミュレーション
農場シミュレーション
games.description: 『Loftia』へようこそ！ほのぼのとしたマルチプレイヤーワールドで、持続可能な明るい未来を作り上げよう。新しいフレンドも、昔からのフレンドも、みんなで一緒に農作業や物作り、探索、装飾などを楽しんで、意味のある変化を生み出そう。

en.name: Loftia
en.description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: フレミング邸の殺人事件
games.shortName: フレミング邸の殺人事件
games.description: 「あなたの任務は、“死亡診断書"を書くこと。」 1959年、霧に包まれた英国・フレミング邸で相次ぐ謎の死。 不気味な現場を調査し、死亡診断書や救急記録を自ら作成せよ。 ヴィンテージな本格ミステリーが好きなあなたに贈る、法医学ミステリー・アドベンチャー。

en.name: Death at Fleming Manor
en.description: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

games.name: DARK PGT 2: The Red Death
games.description: DARK PGT 2 is a dark post-Soviet action game with souls-like elements and black humor. Max Panin wakes up from a coma in a world of mutants, robots, and Soviet experiments. Survive, fight, and figure out who turned everything into this hellish mess.

en.name: DARK PGT 2: The Red Death
en.description: DARK PGT 2 is a dark post-Soviet action game with souls-like elements and black humor. Max Panin wakes up from a coma in a world of mutants, robots, and Soviet experiments. Survive, fight, and figure out who turned everything into this hellish mess.

games.name: BOB LOGISTICS
genres: 職業シミュレーション
games.description: ボブ社へようこそ！注文を確認し、荷物を運び、自動化設備で仕事を少しずつ楽にしましょう。インターンからディレクターへと成長する、ゆったり遊べる一人称倉庫シミュレーター。昇進するほど、会社の新しいエリアと、その裏に隠れた物語が見えてきます。

en.name: BOB LOGISTICS
en.description: Welcome to Bob Company! Fill orders, haul goods, and make work easier with automation. Rise from Intern to Director in a relaxing first-person warehouse sim. Each promotion opens new areas of the company and reveals more of the stories behind it.

games.name: Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaira
games.shortName: GOLDILOCK ONE: THE MISTS OF JAKAIRA
games.description: 強敵を倒し、その攻撃に着想を得た必殺技を解放せよ。このアクションRPGで同盟を結び、仲間を集め、追放の地を生き抜こう。NPCとの交流でソーシャル能力値を高め、店を発展させ、クラフトの選択肢を増やし、さらには操作可能な仲間として迎え入れよう。

en.name: Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaira
en.description: Defeat challenging enemies to unlock special moves inspired by their attacks. Survive exile by forging alliances and rallying companions to your side in this action RPG. Develop social stats with NPCs to upgrade shops, expand crafting options, and even recruit them as playable companions.

games.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
games.description: 深い鬱に陥っていた頃、私は旅に出た。

en.name: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model
en.description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.

games.name: Kill The Frog
games.description: Build an army against frog bosses in this pixel-art incremental/idle game. Earn gold, gems, honey and cheese, grow through skill trees, and equip the BugiVugi King with boss loot. Four rooms, different systems, and an ever-growing force!

en.name: Kill The Frog
en.description: Build an army against frog bosses in this pixel-art incremental/idle game. Earn gold, gems, honey and cheese, grow through skill trees, and equip the BugiVugi King with boss loot. Four rooms, different systems, and an ever-growing force!

games.name: デッドバイデイライト
games.shortName: デッドバイデイライト
games.description: 恐怖に満ちた10年。ジャンプスケアに間一髪の回避、残酷な処刑に手に汗握る脱出劇…それは死と隣り合わせの10年。 不気味な悪が支配する領域に、永遠に閉じ込められた生存者たち…その死にさえ救済のない世界で、粘り強い生存者4人と血に飢えた殺人鬼1人が知恵と度胸の試される残酷なゲームに挑む。最高の非対称マルチプレイホラーゲームで生存者または殺人鬼となり、スリルと恐怖に満ちた世界を堪能しよう。

en.name: Dead by Daylight
en.description: 10 years of horror. 10 years of jump scares and close calls. 10 years of brutal sacrifices and thrilling escapes. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits.

games.name: Escape from Playtime
games.description: 廃墟と化したおもちゃ工場に閉じ込められたあなたと仲間たちが繰り広げる、1～4人向けオンライン協力型ホラーゲーム。目的を明かさぬ謎の声に従って変化し続ける道を探索し、道具を探しながら闇に潜むクリーチャーと生き残りをかけて戦おう。

trailers.name: Release Date Trailer - Escape from Playtime
Everything You Need To Know - Escape From Playtime

en.name: Escape from Playtime
en.description: An online 2-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

games.name: GONE Fishing
games.description: GONE Fishing は、1〜8人で遊べるサバイバルホラーです。仲間と力を合わせ、釣りで生き延びましょう。生き残る唯一の方法は、湖の底なしの飢えを満たし続けること。さもなければ、喰われるのはあなたです。 あなたはその飢えを満たせるか……それとも、次の生贄になるか？

en.name: GONE Fishing
en.description: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you. Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?

games.name: Content Warning
games.description: SpöökTubeでバズるために、怖いことをしているお友達の姿を撮ろう！(一人で行かないことを強くオススメする）

en.name: Content Warning
en.description: Film your friends doing scary things to become SpöökTube famous! (strongly advised to not go alone)

games.name: Shift At Midnight
games.description: 最大3人でオンライン協力プレイを楽しめる、探偵ホラーゲーム。ランダムに生成されたシフトで力を合わせて客を調査し、誰が人間になりすましているかを突き止めよう。一つでもミスをすれば、建物に立てこもって罠を仕掛け、身を隠さなければならない。

en.name: Shift At Midnight
en.description: An online co-op detective horror for up to 3 players. Work together across randomly generated shifts to investigate your customers, as some are only pretending to be human. Make one mistake, and you’ll be forced to board up, set traps, and hide.

games.name: REANIMAL
games.description: Little Nightmares™ I & IIのクリエイターからお届けするダークで恐ろしい冒険。このホラー・アドベンチャーゲームは、ある兄弟が行方不明の友達を助け、故郷の島から逃げ出す物語を描いています。

en.name: REANIMAL
en.description: The creators of Little Nightmares™ I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

games.name: Active Matter
games.description: 崩壊した多元宇宙を舞台にした、この新しいリアルミリタリーシューターで、戦利品を求めて危険なレイドに参加したり、激しいPvPバトルに参加したりしよう。時間と空間を曲げる物質「アクティブマター」の支配権をめぐり、量子不安定ゾーンで戦え。

en.name: Active Matter
en.description: Join dangerous raids for loot or intense PvP/PvE battles in this new realistic military shooter set in a fractured multiverse. Fight in quantum-unstable zones for control of active matter - the substance that bends time and space.

games.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
games.description: 新たなサバイバルホラーが目覚める。『Cronos:The New Dawn』荒廃した未来の世界を生き延び、悪夢のように融合するクリーチャーと戦い、人類を滅ぼした黙示録の真相を探るため、時を遡って魂を狩れ。

en.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
en.description: A whole new breed of survival horror emerges with Cronos: The New Dawn. Survive the brutal wastelands of the future, fight nightmarish merging creatures and jump back in time to harvest souls as you seek to uncover the origins of the apocalypse that wiped out humanity.

games.name: リトルナイトメア3
games.description: 『リトルナイトメア3』はふたりの主人公ロゥとアローンが出口のない“ノーウェア“から抜け出す旅をするサスペンスアドベンチャーゲームです。ふたりで協力してパズルを解き、恐怖に立ち向かいましょう。 オンラインでの2人協力プレイはもちろん、AIとのソロプレイでもお楽しみいただけます。

trailers.name: Little Nightmares III - Pre-Order Trailer - EN

en.name: Little Nightmares III
en.description: Little Nightmares III is an atmospheric adventure game in which you follow the journey of Low and Alone, two best friends in search of a way out of the Nowhere. In 2 players online cooperation or solo with an A.I., work together to solve puzzles and survive in this nightmarish world.

games.name: YAPYAP
games.description: YapYapとは、魔導師となり、ライバルの塔を荒らすために最大5人の友だちを手下として召喚する魔法協力型ホラーゲームだ。様々な呪文を唱え、塔を守る魔獣やモンスターを避けつつ破壊目標を達成せよ。

en.name: YAPYAP
en.description: A magic-themed co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends are minions summoned by a wizard to break into their rival's towers to cause mayhem. Try to fufill your vandalism target with an assortment of spells while avoiding magical beasts and monsters that protect the tower.

games.name: The Headliners
games.description: 協力型ホラーゲームで、1～8人のジャーナリストチームとなり、致命的なクリーチャーに侵略されたニューヨークを探索し、壮大な写真を撮影します。あなたの唯一の目標は、見出しを飾ること...そして、生きてそれを読むことです。

en.name: The Headliners
en.description: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 8 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

games.name: Pacify
games.description: PAH社のために超自然的な生物を鎮め、弱体化させ、捕獲するオンライン協力型ホラーゲームです。各ステージには異なるストーリー、ユニークなモンスター、そして複数のエンディングが用意されています。シングルプレイはもちろん、最大6人の友達と一緒にプレイすることも可能です。楽しいエフェクト付きの近接ボイスチャット機能も搭載されています。

trailers.name: Pacify - New Scary Horror Gameplay Trailer

en.name: Pacify
en.description: An online co-op horror game where you pacify, weaken and capture supernatural creatures for PAH Inc. Each level has a different story, unique monsters, and multiple endings. Play single player or together with up to 6 friends. Includes proximity voice chat with fun effects.

games.name: 零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE
games.description: 今度こそ離さない―― 妖しく羽化する、美しき恐怖。

trailers.name: 『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』ローンチトレーラー
『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』ゲーム紹介トレーラー
『零 ～紅い蝶～ REMAKE』発売日告知トレーラー

en.name: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE
en.description: Together, always.

games.name: The Last of Us™ Part II Remastered
games.shortName: THE LAST OF US PART II REMASTERED
genres: サードパーソンシューティング
games.description: ゲーム・オブ・ザ・イヤーをはじめ300以上のゲームアワードを受賞した作品がPCに登場。進化したグラフィックでエリーとアビーの物語を楽しもう。ローグライクなサバイバル体験が可能なゲームモード「No Return」など、さまざまな新規機能も追加。

en.name: The Last of Us™ Part II Remastered
en.description: Experience the winner of over 300 Game of the Year awards, now on PC. Discover Ellie and Abby’s story with graphical enhancements, gameplay modes like the roguelike survival experience No Return, and more.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.shortName: INTO THE DEAD: OUR DARKEST DAYS
games.description: 1980年、テキサス州の街ウォルトンはゾンビで溢れかえっていた。窮地に立たされた生存者となり、物資を集めて装備を整え、安全なシェルターを探して過酷なサバイバルを乗り越えろ。慎重に計画を立て、力を合わせ、決して立ち止まってはならない——この地獄から生還したいのなら。

en.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
en.description: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.description: 1978年のハロウィンの夜、誰もマイケル・マイヤーズから逃れることはできない。『ハロウィン』でブギーマンになるか、悪の化身に立ち向かうかはあなた次第だ。

en.name: Halloween: The Game
en.description: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: Species: Unknown
games.description: Species: Unknownは1～4人協力プレイ対応のサバイバルホラーです。廃墟となった船で未知の生物に追われながら、危険なミッションを遂行しましょう。生き残り、装備を強化して暗闇に潜む新たな恐怖に立ち向かいましょう。

en.name: Species: Unknown
en.description: Species: Unknown is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

games.name: Dark Hours
games.description: 『Dark Hours』は、1～4人でプレイする協力型サバイバルホラーゲーム。あなたは超自然的な出来事に強盗の邪魔をされ、チームメイトは邪悪な存在に捕らえられてしまう。計画のことは忘れて、生き残ることが先決だ。出口を見つけために、仲間と協力して探索しよう。

en.name: Dark Hours
en.description: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out.

games.name: The Midnight Walk
games.description: 『Lost in Random』のクリエイター陣が贈るアドベンチャー『The Midnight Walk』をプレイしよう。 迷子のランタンと仲良くなり、不思議と恐怖に満ちた世界を照らし出そう。本物の粘土で手作りされ、ストップモーションでアニメ化された風景の中で、モンスターを出し抜き、精巧に表現された不穏な雰囲気を味わい尽くそう。

en.name: The Midnight Walk
en.description: Follow The Midnight Walk in a dark adventure from the minds behind Lost in Random. Befriend a lost lantern creature and light your way through a world of wonder and terror. Outsmart monsters and marvel at details in a landscape handcrafted with real clay and animated in a stop motion style.

games.name: Zort
games.description: Zortは、最大4人で遊べるアクション、アドベンチャー、ホラーゲームです。友達と一緒にマップを探索し、さまざまなクリーチャーから逃げながら楽しんでください。ゲーム内のボイスチャットを使用して、友達とリアルなホラー体験を楽しんでください!

en.name: Zort
en.description: Zort is an action, adventure, and horror game that can be played with up to 4 people. Explore maps with your friends and have fun while escaping from various creatures. Experience a realistic horror experience with in-game voice chat with your friends!

games.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
games.description: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2（エイリアン：ファイアーチーム エリート ２）では、最大4人のプレイヤーが植民地海兵隊員となり、「エイリアン」の世界で最も危険な地へと送り込まれる。これは救助任務ではない——生き残りをかけた戦いだ。ゼノモーフが圧倒的な数で襲いかかり、あらゆる部屋が、あなたの最期の場所になり得る。

en.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2
en.description: This is a fight for survival. Xenomorphs swarm in overwhelming numbers. Every room could be your last.

games.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER
games.description: 『DON’T SCREAM TOGETHER』は、1993年の真っ暗な森を仲間とカメラ片手に歩くオンライン協力型ホラーシミュレーターです。近距離ボイスチャットで協力して脱出を目指そう。ただし誰かが叫ぶとゲームがリスタート、またはハンターとして復活します！

trailers.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER Announcement Teaser Trailer

en.name: DON'T SCREAM TOGETHER
en.description: A very simple co-op jumpscare horror experience where you and friends walk through a pitch black forest and try to stay quiet. Reach 8:00 AM without screaming or making a loud noise, or everyone dies. You will scream, shout, and probably laugh.

games.name: Dead Island 2
games.description: 致命的なウイルスが蔓延し、人々が次々とゾンビに変わっていくロサンゼルス。あなたもゾンビに噛まれ、感染してしまいますが、免疫によって助かります。アウトブレイクの真相を探りながら、自分が何者なのかを解き明かしていきましょう。生き残りながら進化を続け、究極のゾンビスレイヤーとなるのです。

trailers.name: Dead Island 2 Ultimate Edition Launch Trailer
Dead Island 2 Neighborhood Watch Reveal Trailer JPN
Dead Island 2 Steam Launch Trailer JAP

en.name: Dead Island 2
en.description: A deadly virus is spreading across Los Angeles, turning its inhabitants into zombies. Bitten, infected, but more than just immune, uncover the truth behind the outbreak and discover who - or what - you are. Survive, evolve and become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
games.description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it's your job to keep an eye on them!

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
en.description: Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it's your job to keep an eye on them!

games.name: Visage
games.description: Visage は一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。 薄気味悪い慰めと恐ろしいほど現実的な環境が混在する独特の雰囲気のある世界の中、ゆっくりとしたペースで進行します。怪しく、姿を変え続ける家を探索し、真の恐怖をご体験ください。

en.name: Visage
en.description: Visage is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious ever-changing house in a slow-paced, atmospheric world that combines both uncannily comforting and horrifyingly realistic environments, and enjoy a genuinely terrifying experience.

games.name: The Mortuary Assistant
games.description: 隣り合わせの死…。遺体をエンバームして悪霊を追い払い、自身の魂を守れ。

en.name: The Mortuary Assistant
en.description: Alone with the dead... Embalm corpses, banish demons, save your soul.

games.name: [Chilla's Art] The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件
games.description: 夜勤事件は、コンビニの夜勤で働く女子大生に関するJホラーゲームです。

en.name: [Chilla's Art] The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件
en.description: The Convenience Store | 夜勤事件 is a J-horror game about a college girl on a night shift.

games.name: SCP: 5K
games.description: SCP: 5K is a co-op or singleplayer tactical horror FPS project that puts players in the midst of a conspiracy where the SCP Foundation has turned on humanity. Enjoy Early Access as we continue to work towards a completed full release of the project!

en.name: SCP: 5K
en.description: SCP: 5K is a co-op or singleplayer tactical horror FPS project that puts players in the midst of a conspiracy where the SCP Foundation has turned on humanity. Enjoy Early Access as we continue to work towards a completed full release of the project!

games.name: MISERY
games.description: 『MISERY』は、核災害区域を舞台にした1～10人プレイの協力型サバイバルゲーム。ここでは毎日が闘いだ。放射能に汚染された廃墟で資源を探し、バンカーを建設し、武器をクラフトし、仲間と共に自動生成される奇妙な世界を探索しよう。アノマリー、モンスター、そして武装した盗賊には気をつけろ。

en.name: MISERY
en.description: MISERY is a 1–10 player co-op survival game set in a nuclear disaster zone. Here, every day is a struggle: search radioactive ruins for resources, build your bunker, craft weapons, and explore a weird, procedurally-generated world with your friends. Beware of anomalies, monsters, and armed bandits.

games.name: Welcome to Elderfield
genres: 農場シミュレーション
games.description: 「Welcome to Elderfield」は、手描きのアートとダークなLo-Fi音楽でまったりくつろげるホラーRPG。農場を管理したり、近所のみんなと交流したり恋愛したり、ミステリーを調査したり、家を飾ったり、怖いバケモノと戦ったり、釣りをしたり、料理したり、旧神を探したり、眠りながら死んじゃったり、などなど…エルダーフィールドはできることが盛りだくさん！

en.name: Welcome to Elderfield
en.description: Welcome to Elderfield, a cozy horror RPG with hand-drawn art and dark lofi music. Manage your farm, befriend or romance the locals, investigate mysteries, decorate your home, fight terrifying creatures, fish, cook, seek the Old Gods, die in your sleep, and more... There's lots to do in Elderfield!

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
games.shortName: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY'S: SECURITY BREACH
games.description: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breachでは、フレディ・ファズベアのメガ・ピザプレックスに閉じ込められた少年、グレゴリーとなりプレイしてください。フレディ・ファズベア本人の助けを借りながら、グレゴリーはピザプレックスの秘密を明らかにし、真実を追及しながら夜明けまで生き残らなければなりません。

trailers.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach Launch Trailer

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
en.description: In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach, play as Gregory, a young boy who’s been trapped overnight inside of Freddy Fazbear’s Mega Pizzaplex. With the help of Freddy himself, Gregory must uncover the secrets of the Pizzaplex, learn the truth, and survive until dawn.

games.name: BIOHAZARD 2 (1998)
games.description: はじめての任務に向かう途中で大事件に巻き込まれた新人警官の「レオン・Ｓ・ケネディ」と、音信不通となった兄を捜す「クレア・レッドフィールド」の物語が個別に展開。最新の3Dアクセラレーテッドグラフィックスが、リアルな恐怖体験を呼び起こす。

en.name: Resident Evil 2 (1998)
en.description: Command Leon S. Kennedy, a rookie cop who stumbles onto the carnage reporting for his first duty, or play as Claire Redfield, desperately searching for her missing brother. Cutting edge 3-D accelerated graphics that create a terrifying, photo-realistic experience.

games.name: Barotrauma
games.description: 『Barotrauma』は、宇宙サバイバルホラー・潜水艦シュミレーターにRPG要素を加えたの2D協力ゲームです。潜水艦を操作して、ミッションをクリアし、モンスターと戦い、リークを修復して、機械を操作して、銃を使い、アイテムをクラフトします。油断は禁物です：ここでは危険の通知というものが存在しません！

en.name: Barotrauma
en.description: Barotrauma is a 2D co-op submarine simulator – in space, with survival horror and RPG elements. Steer your submarine, complete missions, fight monsters, fix leaks, operate machinery, man the guns and craft items, and stay alert: danger in Barotrauma doesn’t announce itself!

games.name: ヨグ=ソトースの庭
genres: 恋愛シミュレーション
games.description: 「死神」「ドラゴン」「斬霊師」「人造メイド」——個性豊かでキュートなスタッフたちを雇って、負債を抱えたホテルを経営しよう！採掘や冒険・錬金術・レストラン経営etc……多彩な手段で富を築いて、目指すは借金返済！人外スタッフたちとの恋愛模様が魅力の、ホテル経営シム×恋愛ADV！

trailers.name: 公開日決定プロモーションJa

en.name: Yog-Sothoth’s Yard
en.description: Manage a hotel and hire employees including Death, a dragon, a Spirit Hunter, and a bioroid maid. Build your wealth through various means and refine your strategies based on the predictions of Oracles. All employees can be romanced depending on your choices.

games.name: Labyrinthine
games.description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

en.name: Labyrinthine
en.description: A co-op horror game like no other... Play with 1-8 players online as you solve puzzles, collect items and run from the horrors that lie within. Follow in the footsteps of Joan in the story mode or tackle procedurally generated maps that scale with your level and bring a fresh experience each game..

games.name: At Dead Of Night
games.description: At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other.

en.name: At Dead Of Night
en.description: At Dead Of Night is part horror film, part horror game and part ghost hunt. It blends live-action and graphics to create a unique immersive horror experience like no other.

games.name: Trepang2
games.description: 筋金入りのワルになれ。FPS『Trepang2』は、遠い未来を舞台に繰り広げる血なまぐさいアクション満載のFPSゲーム。ハードコアかつ熱狂的なシューティングで敵を完膚なきまでに叩きのめし、銃弾を回避し、破壊の爪痕を残していこう。

en.name: Trepang2
en.description: Become the ultimate badass in Trepang2: A gory, action-packed FPS set in the near future. Unleash all hell on your enemies, dodge bullets and leave a trail of destruction in this hardcore and frenetic shooter.

games.name: Emissary Zero
games.description: 協力型ホラー (1～4 人用)。夜に謎の建物を探索するよう命じられます。月を見つけて、生きて帰れるように努力しましょう。

en.name: Emissary Zero
en.description: Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

games.name: Hell Clock
games.description: 無限の戦利品で強力なビルドを作り上げ、終わりなきローグライクとアクションRPGの融合を体験せよ。ダンジョンを攻略し、ブラジルのカヌードスの戦争を題材にしたダークファンタジーの世界で、人ならざる力を解き放て。

trailers.name: Journey of Miracles Update | Dev Preview
Hell Clock: Cursed War | Launch Trailer
Hell Clock: Cursed War | Skills Trailer

en.name: Hell Clock
en.description: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

games.name: PANICORE (パニコアー)
games.description: PANICOREは、パーマデス、AIモンスター、協力プレイをミックスしたサバイバルホラーゲームだ。捕まらないように脱出を試みるが、注意：彼らはあなたの足音だけでなく、声も聞いている。

en.name: PANICORE
en.description: PANICORE is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience up to 5 players (4 players in demo). Try to escape and don't get caught, but beware: they don't only hear your steps, but also your voice.

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.description: 最大4人の協力プレイで探検家として徒党を組み、財宝を探し求めよう。この呪われし密林にはそこかしこに危険が潜み、モンスターたちが現実を塗り替える。狂気に抗い密林を制覇しなければ、己自身が密林に貪られてしまうのだ…

en.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
en.description: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Inside the Backrooms
games.description: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

en.name: Inside the Backrooms
en.description: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

games.name: 殺戮の天使
games.description: 「お願い、私を殺して」「一緒にここから出る手助けをしてくれよ。そしたらお前を、殺してやるよ」 『殺戮の天使』はエピソード1からエピソード4の4部構成からなるサイコホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。

en.name: Angels of Death
en.description: "Please... kill me." "Help me get outta here, and I'll kill you." ~ Angels of Death is a psychological horror-adventure game, consisting of four episodes.

games.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite
games.description: 『Aliens: Fireteam Elite』は、アイコニックなエイリアンの世界が舞台となった、協力型三人称視点サバイバルゲームです。異なる種類のゼノモーフの大群と戦いながら、キャラクターやギアをカスタマイズして、どんどん大きくなっていく脅威を抑えながらレベルアップを繰り返していきましょう。

en.name: Aliens: Fireteam Elite
en.description: Aliens: Fireteam Elite is a cooperative third-person survival game set in the iconic Alien Universe. Battle through hordes of different types of Xenomorph, customize your character and gear, and level-up as you try to contain this ever-growing threat.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
games.description: Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza! As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
en.description: Welcome back to the new and improved Freddy Fazbear's Pizza! As always, Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.

games.name: Horripilant
games.description: 己の神を討ち、己の力を示せ。Horripilantは忘れ去られた地下世界の恐怖を次第に体験していくダンジョンRPGです。放置ゲーム、パズル、オートバトルの要素を組み合わせ、廃ダンジョンの深部を進むために、戦い、採掘し、謎を解いていきます。

en.name: Horripilant
en.description: KILL YOUR GOD. BECOME WORTHY. Horripilant is a chilling idle incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld.

games.name: Demonologist
games.description: Demonologistは、最低1人、最大4人で遊べるCo-Opホラーゲームです。呪われた場所にいる悪霊の種類を特定し、装備を駆使して悪霊を祓うことが目的です、一人でもチームでも楽しめます。

en.name: Demonologist
en.description: Demonologist is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. Your goal is to identify the type of evil spirit in cursed places and exorcise it using your equipment, either alone or with your team.

games.name: Murky Divers
games.description: ソロまたは最大8人のプレイヤー。放棄された水中研究所から、雇い主の失敗した実験の痕跡を消去しなければならない。潜水艦を操縦し、深淵の恐ろしいものを避けつつ、全ての死体を排除しよう。

en.name: Murky Divers
en.description: Solo or up to 8 players. Get rid of your employer's failed experiments in abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, avoid abyssal terrors, and remove all corpses.

games.name: biohazard 0 HD REMASTER
games.description: シリーズ累計販売本数6,500万本を超える『バイオハザード』シリーズ。 その出発点である「洋館事件」の始まりが描かれた作品「biohazard 0」をHDリマスター化。 秘められた恐怖と謎を、あなた自身で体験してもらいたい。 【イーライセンス利用許諾番号】ID34094

en.name: Resident Evil 0
en.description: Before the mansion, before the destruction of Raccoon City, there was Resident Evil 0. Now remastered with improved visuals and sounds, as well as the all-new Wesker Mode, there's never been a better time to experience the origins of the Resident Evil story.

games.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope
games.shortName: THE DARK PICTURES ANTHOLOGY: LITTLE HOPE
games.description: 廃墟の街『リトル・ホープ』に閉じ込められ孤立した4人の学生と教授は、深い霧の奥から執拗に追いかけてくる悪夢のような化け物から逃げなければなりません。

en.name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope
en.description: Trapped and isolated in the abandoned town of Little Hope, 4 college students and their teacher must escape the nightmarish apparitions that relentlessly pursue them through an impenetrable fog.

games.name: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream
games.shortName: I HAVE NO MOUTH, AND I MUST SCREAM
games.description: The adventure plunges you into the tortured and hidden past of five humans. Delve into their darkest fears. Outwit the Master Computer AM in a game of psychological warfare. Disturbing, compelling. An adventure you won't easily forget !!

trailers.name: I Have No Mouth and I Must Scream Trailer

en.name: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream
en.description: The adventure plunges you into the tortured and hidden past of five humans. Delve into their darkest fears. Outwit the Master Computer AM in a game of psychological warfare. Disturbing, compelling. An adventure you won't easily forget !!

games.name: Endacopia
games.description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

en.name: Endacopia
en.description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

games.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
games.description: 自分の体験と『Fears to Fathom』のあるエピソードの間にある背筋が凍るような類似点に気づいたテッサとマーカスは、自分たちのエピソードを共有することにした。『Scratch Creek』は、オンライン限定の協力プレイ専用タイトルだ。

en.name: Fears to Fathom® - Scratch Creek
en.description: After noticing bone-chilling similarities to an episode of Fears to Fathom, Tessa and Marcus decide to share their own experience. Scratch Creek is an exclusively online co-op experience.

games.name: Call of Cthulhu®
games.description: 1924. Private Investigator Pierce is sent to look into the tragic death of the Hawkins family. Plunge into a world of creeping madness and cosmic horror. Cryptic clues, shadowy figures, and pure terror bar your way as you fight to retain your sanity and solve an otherworldly mystery.

en.name: Call of Cthulhu®
en.description: 1924. Private Investigator Pierce is sent to look into the tragic death of the Hawkins family. Plunge into a world of creeping madness and cosmic horror. Cryptic clues, shadowy figures, and pure terror bar your way as you fight to retain your sanity and solve an otherworldly mystery.

games.name: Dead Space™ 2
genres: サードパーソンシューティング
games.description: ネクロモーフがUSGイシムラに蔓延してから3年後、スプロールと呼ばれる宇宙ステーションで、昏睡状態だったアイザック・クラークはもうろうと混濁した意識のなか目覚める。新しい世界と無重力環境を探索して、ユニトロジーの真実とネクロモーフの蔓延の理由を突き止めよう。

en.name: Dead Space™ 2
en.description: Three years after the Necromorph infestation aboard the USS Ishimura, Isaac Clarke awakens from a coma, confused, disoriented, and on a space station called The Sprawl. Explore this world and its zero-g environments to discover the truth about the Unitology and its role in the Necromorph epidemic.

games.name: Nine-Ball Roulette
games.description: これは、あなたが今までプレイした中で最もスリリングなビリヤードゲームになります。友達を最大3人参加させ、このエキサイティングなプールルーレットゲームに挑もう！最後の一人になるまでプールで相手を排除してください。

en.name: Nine-Ball Roulette
en.description: This will be the most thrilling pool game you have ever played. Join up to 3 of your friends in this exciting pool roulette game! Eliminate each other with pool until only one person is left.

games.name: Crisol: Theater of Idols
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
games.description: 『Crisol: Theater of Idols』は、一人称視点のホラーアクションアドベンチャー。舞台は、スペインにタッチを加えて再現した世界、「ヒスパニア」です。プレイヤーは兵士ガブリエルとなり、自らの血を武器および命綱に、太陽神失踪の謎を解き明かす旅に出ます。呪われた島、トルメントーサを探索し、秘密を解き明かし、おぞましい敵と対峙しましょう。さて、最後まで生き残ることはできるのでしょうか？

en.name: Crisol: Theater of Idols
en.description: Crisol is a survival horror adventure set in a twisted version of Spain. As a soldier captured by religious dogmatism, you must use your own blood as ammunition, without draining to the point of death. Explore the cursed island of Tormentosa, uncover dark secrets, and battle horrifying enemies.

games.name: Misao - 2024 HD Remaster
games.description: 行方不明の少女・操（みさお）を巡り、怪異がはびこる学校を探索するホラーアドベンチャー。2017年リリースの『Definitive Edition』からグラフィックを刷新し、HD画質に対応。さらに姿を変えた恐怖体験を味わってください。

trailers.name: 『Misao - 2024 HD Remaster』リリーストレーラー

en.name: Misao - 2024 HD Remaster
en.description: Explore a school plagued by unnatural phenomena in this horror-adventure game revolving around the missing girl Misao. Improving upon 2017's "Definitive Edition" with refreshed graphics and support for HD resolutions, you can now experience the terror in a new form.

games.name: Oh Deer
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
games.description: ハンター1人、最大4人の友達がシカに変装しています。 このスリリングなかくれんぼゲームでは、すべての動きが最後かもしれません。 あなたは群れに紛れるか、目立ちますか？ オー、シカ...

en.name: Oh Deer
en.description: One hunter & up to 9 friends disguised as deer. A game of hide-and-seek where every move could be your last. Will you blend in with the herd or stand out? Oh Deer...

games.name: Killer Frequency
games.description: Killer Frequencyは、深夜ラジオ番組の司会者Forrest Nashとしてプレイする1人称ホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。電話をかけてくる人々は、リアルタイムで謎の殺人鬼に追われています。ジュークボックスから流れるレトロな80年代音楽を聴きながら、謎を解き、人命救助し、交換台を操作しましょう！

en.name: Killer Frequency
en.description: Killer Frequency is a first-person horror puzzle game set in 1987, that puts you in the role of a late-night radio talk show host in small town America whose callers are being stalked by a mysterious killer.

games.name: Quake 4
games.description: "プレイヤーはエリート部隊Rhino Squadの一員として、敵エイリアンの母星へ進攻する地球軍のために先陣を切らなければならない。しかし、人類の存亡をかけた絶望的な戦争で、容赦ない敵に立ち向かうための方法があるとすれば… それは彼らの一人になるということなのかもしれない。 ※本製品では日本語はサポートされていません"

en.name: Quake 4
en.description: As part of the elite Rhino Squad, you must spearhead Earth’s military invasion of a hostile alien homeworld. But, in this desperate war for humanity’s survival against an unrelenting enemy, you may discover that the only way to defeat them...is to become one of them.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
games.description: In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows.

en.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
en.description: In this last chapter of the Five Nights at Freddy's original story, you must once again defend yourself against Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and even worse things that lurk in the shadows.

games.name: DON'T SCREAM
games.description: 叫んだら即終了。2人の作者により、Unreal Engine 5を駆使して開発された短編ホラゲー。クリア条件は、なんと「叫ばずに18分間森を探索する」…だけ？と思いきや、「時間が経過するのは移動中のみ」という特別ルールあり。お友達やご家族を徹底的にビビらせたい方は必見！プレイにはマイクが必須です！

en.name: DON'T SCREAM
en.description: If you scream, you restart. A jumpscare horror simulator where you walk through a pitch black forest and escape by reaching 8:00 AM.

games.name: Cabernet
games.description: 『Cabernet』は、近代的なひねりを加えた19世紀の東ヨーロッパ風世界が舞台の2DナラティブRPG。無防備な村人たちの間で新たなアンデッド生活を送る、うら若き吸血鬼のLizaを導こう。あなたは人間性を失わずにいることができるのか。それともさらなる恐怖へと成り果ててしまうのか。

en.name: Cabernet
en.description: Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in a 19th century Eastern European inspired world, with a modern twist. Guide Liza, a young vampire in her new unlife among the unsuspecting townsfolk. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become?

games.name: Mad Father (マッドファーザー)
games.shortName: MAD FATHER (マッドファーザー)
games.description: あなたが見届けるのは、愚かな家族の物語。 名作と名高い探索型ホラーゲームのリメイク版が登場。

en.name: Mad Father
en.description: Witness the tale of a most foolish family. A remake of the classic horror exploration game makes its way to Steam.

games.name: System Shock
genres: 没入シミュレーション
games.description: 深宇宙で生死をかけて戦うファースト・パーソン・ファイト

en.name: System Shock
en.description: A first-person fight to the death in the depths of space!

games.name: FAITH: The Unholy Trinity
games.description: これから行おうとしていることは、バチカンによって承認されていません。

en.name: FAITH: The Unholy Trinity
en.description: What you are about to do has not been approved by the Vatican. As a young priest, struggle against demons, cultists, and your own weakening faith in this pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming and the "Satanic Panic" of the 1980s.

games.name: Alien Shooter
games.description: The endless darkness and the somber, long passages of a military complex have become the abode of evil, thousands of blood-thirsty creatures fill its offices, storehouses and mysterious laboratories. About 1,000 monsters on each map, showing up to 100 monsters simultaneously on one playing screen.

en.name: Alien Shooter
en.description: The endless darkness and the somber, long passages of a military complex have become the abode of evil, thousands of blood-thirsty creatures fill its offices, storehouses and mysterious laboratories. About 1,000 monsters on each map, showing up to 100 monsters simultaneously on one playing screen.

games.name: Emily Wants To Play
games.description: Emily Wants to Playは、戦略要素のある怖いサバイバルホラーゲームです。あなたは、エミリーと彼女の3つの人形によって捕捉されるピザの配達人として再生されます。人形は生きていて、彼らはあなたと一緒に家を歩き回っています。

trailers.name: Emily Wants To Play Official Trailer
Emily Wants To Play GamePlay Teaser

en.name: Emily Wants To Play
en.description: It’s 11pm and the last house on your route. The windows are boarded up, the yard is overgrown, but the lights are on and the front door is open… strange place to deliver a pizza. You’re getting soaked from the rain, so you hesitantly step inside the house. You shouldn’t have done that.

games.name: House
games.description: Try to survive through the night in a house that's trying its best to kill you and your family.

en.name: House
en.description: Try to survive through the night in a house that's trying its best to kill you and your family.

games.name: BIOHAZARD 3 LAST ESCAPE (1999)
games.description: あの忌まわしい洋館事件の生存者である「ジル・バレンタイン」を操り、悪夢の続きを目撃せよ。S.T.A.R.S.を辞め、ラクーンシティからの脱出を目論む彼女を待っていたのは、新たな困難だった。人間を捕食するゾンビで溢れた街から生きて逃げ出すには、知恵と力を最大限に振り絞らなければならない。

en.name: Resident Evil 3 Nemesis (1999)
en.description: Join Jill Valentine, the survivor of the notorious disaster, as her nightmare continues. After resigning from S.T.A.R.S. Jill now prepares to head out of Raccoon City… but caught in a town crawling with zombies, more than ever she must rely on brute force and cunning to find a way to escape alive.

games.name: Among Us 3D: VR
genres: ソーシャルディダクション
games.description: 仮想現実で繰り広げられる、ソーシャル推理パーティーゲームの決定版！クルーが生き延びるか、インポスターが圧倒するか？ロール、緊急会議、偽装、サボタージュ、タスク：大人気のオリジナルのAmong USのカオスを、VRで楽しもう。

trailers.name: Among Us 3D: VR Definitive Edition Update Trailer

en.name: Among Us 3D: VR
en.description: The definitive social deduction party game in virtual reality! Can the Crewmates survive, or will Impostors take over? Roles, Emergency Meetings, deception, sabotages, tasks: enjoy your favorite brand of chaos from the original Among Us with a VR twist.

games.name: Rusty Lake Paradise
games.description: Rusty Lake Paradiseの舞台はエジプトの十の災いによって呪われた小さな離島です。暗く不気味なパズルアドベンチャーに挑戦し全ての謎を解き明かしましょう。Paradiseは独特の雰囲気とワクワク感を持つRusty Lakeシリーズの作品です。

en.name: Rusty Lake Paradise
en.description: Rusty Lake Paradise is set on a small remote island which is cursed by the ten plagues of Egypt. Solve all the mysteries of this dark, macabre puzzle adventure. Paradise builds upon the distinctive atmosphere and excitement from the Rusty Lake series.

games.name: Amenti
games.description: A photographer enters the Great Pyramids to photograph Pharaoh Rudamon’s remains, but is soon overwhelmed by a sinister curse, as the ancient tomb awakens dark forces that claw at his sanity.

en.name: Amenti
en.description: A photographer enters the Great Pyramids to photograph Pharaoh Rudamon’s remains, but is soon overwhelmed by a sinister curse, as the ancient tomb awakens dark forces that claw at his sanity.

games.name: Rusty Lake: Roots
games.description: 登場するキャラクターたちの生と死を経験して、独自の家系図を作ろう！ Rusty Lake: RootsはCube Escapeシリーズのクリエイターたちによるポイントクリック型の謎解きアドベンチャーゲームであるRusty Lake Hotelの続編です。

en.name: Rusty Lake: Roots
en.description: Experience the beginning and end of characters' lives and build your own family tree! Rusty Lake: Roots is the second premium point-and-click adventure by the creators of the Cube Escape series and Rusty Lake Hotel.

games.name: The Excavation of Hob's Barrow
games.description: The Excavation of Hob's Barrow is a folk horror narrative-driven adventure. Explore the isolated moors of rural Victorian England as you uncover the mysteries of Hob's Barrow. The answers lie in the soil...

trailers.name: Excavation of Hob's Barrow - launch trailer
Excavation of Hob's Barrow - teaser trailer

en.name: The Excavation of Hob's Barrow
en.description: The Excavation of Hob's Barrow is a folk horror narrative-driven adventure. Explore the isolated moors of rural Victorian England as you uncover the mysteries of Hob's Barrow. The answers lie in the soil...

games.name: I'm on Observation Duty
games.description: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?

trailers.name: I'm on Observation Duty trailer Update 1.1

en.name: I'm on Observation Duty
en.description: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?

games.name: Depth（デプス）
games.description: 暗い水中の世界でサメかダイバーとして遊び、カンニング、チームワーク、ステルスなどを利用して敵を乗り越えよう。Depthはテンションと本能的なアクションを組み合わせ、AIに対してチームを組むか他のプレイヤーと心臓が高鳴る戦いのマッチを行う。

en.name: Depth
en.description: Play as a shark or a diver in a dark aquatic world and overcome your enemies by employing cunning, teamwork, and stealth. Depth blends tension and visceral action as you team up against AI or be matched with other players in heart pounding combat.

games.name: Cube Escape Collection
games.description: この独特なポイント＆クリック式アドベンチャーゲームのコレクションでは、デールやローラをはじめ、ミスター・クロウ、ミスター・アウルなどラスティレイクで人気のキャラクターの足跡をたどります。Flashゲームの終わりに備え、アップデートされたゲームを一つにまとめた新装版が新たに登場。

en.name: Cube Escape Collection
en.description: In this classic point-and-click adventure anthology you follow the path of Dale and Laura and other famous Rusty lake characters such as Mr. Crow and Mr. Owl. The series will be updated, preserved and bundled to survive the end of the Flash Games era.

games.name: 人喰ノ檻 - KLETKA
games.description: KLETKA(クレトカ)は、君たち囚人を捕食しようとするエレベーターに乗って、地下深くへ降りていく協力型ホラーゲームだ。エレベーターに食べられないよう餌を与え、トラップやモンスターを避け、地下深くまで降りていこう。

en.name: KLETKA
en.description: KLETKA is a co-op (up to 6 players) horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.name: Look Outside
games.description: これは、アパートの一室から始まるサバイバルホラーRPG。謎だらけの出来事によって、窓の外を見た者はグロテスクな化け物へと姿を変えられ、世界を本物の混沌へと陥れる。建物の中を調べ回って食糧、物資、武器を探し出せ。そして奇妙な者たちと出会うことになるだろう。

en.name: Look Outside
en.description: Look Outside is a survival horror RPG set in a single apartment building. A mysterious event turns anyone who looks out the window into grotesque monsters, leaving the world in absolute chaos. Scavenge the building to seek food, supplies, and weapons while encountering strange characters.

games.name: Ravenous Devils
games.description: 犯罪を隠し味にした、ホラークッキングシミュレーター。お店を改善して、新しい道具を買って、メニューを増やして、何よりも、お客さんに喜んでもらいましょう。

trailers.name: Ravenous Devils Trailer - Horror Cooking Simulator

en.name: Ravenous Devils
en.description: A horror cooking simulator where the secret ingredient is crime. Improve your shops, buy new tools, expand your menu, and above all, make your customers happy.

games.name: Kiosk
games.description: 『Kiosk』は、雨に濡れた居心地の良いキオスクで深夜に訪れるお客様の注文を調理・提供するホラークッキングゲームです。不気味な雰囲気と緊張感が高まる中、謎めいた訪問者たちに応対します。

en.name: Kiosk
en.description: Kiosk is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for late-night customers who visit your cozy, rain-soaked kiosk. The eerie atmosphere clashes with the mounting tension as you serve your mysterious visitors.

games.name: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs
games.description: 借り物の魔法を宿す、声なき小さな存在。囁き返す一軒家。誤って言問えば、こちらの名を呼ぶ何かが目覚めるかもしれない。

en.name: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs
en.description: A mute little thing with borrowed magic. A house that murmurs back. Ask wrong, and you might wake something that remembers your name.

games.name: That's not my Neighbor
games.description: 1955年、何らかの理由でドッペルゲンガーが通常より多く見られるようになっています。そのため、ドッペルゲンガー検出局（D.D.D.）が対策を講じました。 あなたはアパートの管理人で、自分の隣人だと主張する人を通すかどうかを判断する必要があります。

en.name: That's not my Neighbor
en.description: It's 1955, and for unknown reasons, doppelgangers are more common than usual. Therefore, the Department of Doppelganger Detection (D.D.D.) has taken action. You are the doorman of an apartment complex, and you must decide whether to let in those who claim to be your neighbors.

games.name: Stories Untold
games.description: Stories Untold is a compilation tape of four experimental adventures, including a remaster of the original hit episode “The House Abandon”.

en.name: Stories Untold
en.description: Stories Untold is a compilation tape of four experimental adventures, including a remaster of the original hit episode “The House Abandon”.

games.name: RATSHAKER™
games.description: 楽しくってクセ強めのRATSHAKER™で、ネズミにまつわる問題はすべて解決！ネズミをにぎってシェイクすれば、日々の悩みなんてきれいサッパリ！行けるところまで行っちゃおう！

en.name: RATSHAKER™
en.description: RATSHAKER™ is the fun and quirky solution to all your rat problems! Hold on to the RAT, shake your arm, and watch life’s problems disappear! How far can you go?

games.name: ミスター・ファーリー：熱い筋肉
games.shortName: ミスター・ファーリー：熱い筋肉
games.description: 筋肉質のミスター・ファーリー、深い陰謀、毛皮のようなダンジョンの不気味な雰囲気を備えたユニークな毛皮の恐怖。ホットミルク、ジム、ゲイバーなど！ミスター・ファーリーからの罰を逃れることができますか？

en.name: Mister Furry: Hot Muscles
en.description: ♂ Unique Furry Horror with Muscular Mister Furries, Deep Plot, Great Sound Effects and Creepy Atmosphere of Furry Dungeon. Hot Milk, Dungeon Items, Gym, Gay-Bar, Pool, Locker Room, Atmospheric Music and much more! Will you be able to escape punishment from Mister Furry? ♂

games.name: Blood and Bacon
games.description: このマルチプレイCO -OP 」最初の人のシューティングゲームは「昼と夜のレベルは、プレイヤーはあなたが探検のように、 10日ごとに巨大なモンスターとMinibossesのように、 35敵の種類と多数のボスを取る撃つとブタの猛攻撃に対してあなたの人生のために実行されてい怪物。

en.name: Blood and Bacon
en.description: This Co-op Shooter , has Day and Night levels, multiple maps, players will take on 25 enemy types and numerous bosses, like Gargantuan Monsters and Minibosses every 10 days as you explore, shoot and run for your life against the onslaught of porcine monstrosities.

games.name: Crow Country
games.description: 時は1990年。「エドワード・クロウ」の謎の失踪と、彼のテーマパーク「クロウ・カントリー」の突然の閉園から2年が過ぎた。主人公「マーラ・フォレスト」がやってきたことで、その沈黙は破られる。真実を知るには、クロウ・カントリーの暗い奥深くへと進み、答えを見つけ出すしかない…。

en.name: Crow Country
en.description: The year is 1990. It’s been two years since the mysterious disappearance of Edward Crow and the abrupt closure of his theme park, Crow Country. But your arrival has broken the silence, Mara Forest. If you want answers, you’ll have to venture deep into the darkness of Crow Country to find them…

games.name: Carnival Hunt
games.description: Carnival Huntは、5対1の一人称視点非対称ホラーゲーム。5体のぜんまい仕掛けのウサギは、音を立てる鍵を管理し、姿を変えるカーニバルから協力して脱出しなければならない。もう1人のプレイヤーはカーニバル・モンスターとなり、彼らを狩る。

en.name: Carnival Hunt
en.description: Carnival Hunt is a 5v1 first-person asymmetrical horror game. Five wind-up Bunnies must work together, manage their noisy keys, and find a way to escape an ever-changing carnival world while one player hunts them as the Carnival Monster.

games.name: Saiko no sutoka
games.description: Saiko No Sutokaは主人公として、あなたの死を望んでいる狂ったヤンデレの女の子から逃げるホラーサバイバルゲームです。

en.name: Saiko no sutoka
en.description: Saiko No Sutoka is a Horror Survival Game where you as a Protagonist must escape and avoid the crazy yandere girl who wants you dead.

games.name: ペンギンホテル2 -スネークペンギンの野望-
games.shortName: ペンギンホテル2 -スネークペンギンの野望-
games.description: マスコットホラー：「ペンギンホテル」第2章 スネークペンギンがあなたを狙っている。不思議なカメラで謎を解き、突き進め！

en.name: PENGUIN HOTEL 2 -Snake Penguin Ambition-
en.description: Mascot Horror: "Penguin Hotel" Chapter 2 The Snake Penguin is after you. Solve mysteries with a mysterious camera and push forward!

games.name: Ecstatica
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
games.description: 『Ecstatica』は悪魔に呪われた中世の村ティリッヒを舞台とするサバイバルホラーゲームのパイオニアだ。全てが楕円体で表現されたワールドを探索し、悪夢のような怪物たちをやり過ごすか戦い、パズルを解き、呪いを打ち消そう。

en.name: Ecstatica
en.description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

games.name: 恐怖夜話 第二夜
games.description: 雨の夜、古びた純喫茶で語られる三つの怪談――。オカルト雑誌のライターである「あなた」は、三人の体験者の語りに耳を傾ける。テキストと音でじわじわと恐怖を積み重ねる、サイコロジカルホラーノベル『恐怖夜話 第二夜』。

en.name: Kyofu Yawa: Second Night
en.description: Three ghost stories, told in an old café on a rainy night. As a writer for an occult magazine, you listen to three people recount their experiences. Text and sound slowly build the dread in the psychological horror visual novel Kyofu Yawa: Second Night.

games.name: Trash Bunny House
games.description: 原因不明の死亡事故が頻発し、製造中止となった某遊園地の幻のアニマトロニクスたち。 随分昔に廃棄されたはずの彼らが、地方の廃工場に残っているというタレコミがありました。 我が出版社はこの件をあなたに一任します。良いスクープ写真を撮ってきてください。

en.name: Trash Bunny House
en.description: Animatronics for an amusement park, whose production stopped due to frequently occurring and unexplained fatal accidents. We got a tip-off that some remain in an abandoned rural factory. Our publishing company will leave this up to you. Take good photos for the scoop.

games.name: ■■になってくれませんか？
games.description: 誰でも日常で経験あるうかつな返事。うかつな返事をした代償を描いた恐怖。 全5つのEND短編周回型ジャパニーズホラー・ウォーキングシミュレーターゲーム。

en.name: ■■になってくれませんか？
en.description: 誰でも日常で経験あるうかつな返事。うかつな返事をした代償を描いた恐怖。 全5つのEND短編周回型ジャパニーズホラー・ウォーキングシミュレーターゲーム。

games.name: Gateholt
games.description: Gateholtは1〜4人でプレイする協力ホラーゲームです。呪われた場所に入り、悪霊が残した痕跡を消してください。痕跡を消すほど、それは近づいてきます。立ち向かうことはできません。逃げるか、隠れてください。戻る道はまだ開いています。

en.name: Gateholt
en.description: Gateholt is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Enter a cursed place and erase the marks an evil spirit has left behind. Every mark you erase brings it closer. You cannot fight it — run, or hide. The way back is still open.

games.name: ひぐらしのなく頃に奉 目明し編
games.shortName: ひぐらしのなく頃に奉 目明し編
games.description: 【ひぐらしのなく頃に解 目明し編】本作品は日本語モード、英語モードを搭載したサウンドノベルです。音楽や背景、キャラクターによって楽しく演出された世界を、小説の感覚で読み進んで行きます。笑ったり、泣いたり、怒ったり。そんな心の揺らめきを主人公と一緒に堪能して下さい。

en.name: Higurashi When They Cry Hou - Ch.5 Meakashi

trailers.name: Life and Shadow: Celestial Call - Trailer
