en.description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Rome landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

floor2.name: 焼肉パーティーサバイバル
floor2.shortName: 焼肉パーティーサバイバル
floor2.description: 焼肉屋さんの食材だけでどれだけ生き延びられるか挑戦するゲームです。栄養バランスを考えて生き延びて、出来るだけたくさん食べてください。おなかがいっぱいになったら、スクワットでおなかを減らしてください。

en.name: Yakiniku Party Survival
en.description: This is a game where you challenge yourself to survive using only the ingredients from a yakiniku restaurant. Survive by maintaining a balanced diet and eat as much as you can. If your stomach gets full, burn off calories with squats to get hungry again!

floor2.name: Chocolate makes you happy: St.Patrick's Day
floor2.description: 『Chocolate makes you happy: St.Patrick's Day』はクッキーとチョコ、クローバー、虹が登場する2D物理パズルゲームです。50のステージでチョコバーの上にクッキーを乗せましょう（反重力やコンベアを活用）。罠や爆発を避け、論理力と正確性を試そう！

trailers.name: Chocolate makes you happy: St.Patrick's Day

en.name: Chocolate makes you happy: St.Patrick's Day
en.description: Chocolate makes you happy: St.Patrick's Day is a colorful 2D physics puzzle game with cookies, chocolate, clovers, and rainbows. Balance cookies on a chocolate bar across 50 levels using reverse gravity, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, and treadmills while avoiding traps and explosions.

floor2.name: Chill Drive Together
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 終わりのない道、一人か二人のドライバー、そしてその先には何も待っていません。キー一つで車のまわりの世界が変わります——ロード画面はありません。十六台の車、五つの環境。解除するものはなく、行くべき場所もありません。

en.name: Chill Drive Together
en.description: An endless road, one or two drivers, and nothing waiting at the end of it. One key changes the world around the car — no loading screen. Sixteen cars, five environments. Nothing to unlock, nowhere to be.

floor2.name: Say No! More
floor2.description: あなたは「ノー！」という言葉が許されない会社の実習生。どんな雑用や無理難題に対しても「イエス！」という返事が求められている…。そんなときに偶然見つけた古いカセットテープを聞いて、今から「ノー！」と言える人間に生まれ変わろう！

en.name: Say No! More
en.description: SAY NO! MORE is the world’s first NPG (NO!-Playing Game). Play as an intern with a burning desire to say NO! to everything and everyone. Customize your character, say NO! in different styles and languages, clap back at mean colleagues and change the world!

floor2.name: ねこねこ釣り日記
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
floor2.description: 学びや仕事のお供に、静かに釣りをする癒しのパートナー。子猫のフィッシャーがデスクトップでのんびり釣りをしながら、あなたの作業をそっと見守る。たまに様子を確認して、新しい魚を見つけたり、釣り竿を強化したり、水槽を拡張したりするだけでいい。穏やかな時間を楽しもう。

en.name: Fischer's Fishing Journey
en.description: Put Fischer on your desktop as your ultimate study and work buddy. He'll fish quietly in the corner, taking care of it all—you just drop in occasionally to collect your rewards, unlock new fish, upgrade your rod, while enjoying that calming, healing atmosphere.

floor2.name: ８番出口
floor2.description: あなたは無限に続く地下通路に閉じ込められている。 周囲をよく観察し、「８番出口」まで辿り着こう。

en.name: The Exit 8
en.description: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach "The Exit 8".

floor2.name: 蜀末：三国血月伝
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
floor2.description: 蜀末：三国血月伝は、プレイヤーが蜀の将軍の役割を担うターン制のローグライク カード ゲームです。ダンジョンを探索し、宝物を集め、カードのコレクションを蓄積します。カードと宝物の独特な組み合わせを作り、さまざまな敵に打ち勝ちます。

en.name: Three Kingdoms: The Blood Moon
en.description: Three Kingdoms: The Blood Moon is a turn-based Roguelike card game where you assume the role of a Shu general. Explore dungeons, gather relics, and amass a collection of cards. In each round, you can assemble a unique combination of cards and treasures to defeat your enemies and rewrite history!

floor2.name: Brotato
floor2.description: Brotatoは、トップダウン アリーナ シューターのローグライトです。一度に最大6つの武器を駆使してポテトを操作し、エイリアンの大群を撃退していきます。さまざまな特性とアイテムから選択して、自分だけのビルドにし、助けが来るまで生き残りましょう。

trailers.name: Full Release Trailer - Local Co-Op Update

en.name: Brotato
en.description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

floor2.name: Boxville
floor2.description: Boxville は、箱の街に住む無言の缶がダンボールにいたずら書きを描いて物語を語るアドベンチャー パズル ゲームです。 ウクライナ製。

en.name: Boxville
en.description: Boxville is an adventure puzzle game about speechless cans living in the city of boxes and drawing doodles on cardboards to tell the stories. Made in Ukraine.

floor2.name: ニンニク建築家
floor2.description: はユニークな建築ゲームです。 ガーリック・ファミリーの新世代ビルダー、ガーリック・ホワットとして、父親の建築ハンマーを受け継ぎ、様々な注文を受け、図面通りに、あるいは想像力を駆使して、顧客の奇妙な要求を満たすことができるだろうか？

en.name: Garlic Builder
en.description: Garlic Builder is a unique building game. As the new builder of the Garlic Family, can you inherit your father's building hammer, take various orders, follow the blueprint, or use your imagination to fulfill the strange needs of your customers?

floor2.name: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ参
floor2.shortName: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ参
floor2.description: 江戸時代を舞台にした、オンライン協力プレイ型のコインプッシャーゲーム「古銭プッシャーフレンズ」のシリーズ3作目です。今作では、東海道五十三次をテーマにしたすごろくがあり、止まったマスによって様々なイベントが発生します。他のプレイヤーと協力して妖怪を退治したり、悪代官を成敗したり、ジャックポットを目指したりしましょう。ゲームを進めると様々な方法で能力アップできます。

en.name: Old Coin Pusher Friends 3
en.description: In this installment, there is a Sugoroku themed around the old Japan, with various events triggered by the squares you land on. Work together with other players to defeat yokai, and aim for the jackpot. As you progress in the game, you can enhance your abilities with various upgrades.

floor2.name: ゴブリン・ノーム・ホーン
floor2.shortName: ゴブリン・ノーム・ホーン
floor2.description: 手描きのグラフィックと愉快でシュールな世界観の2D横スクロールアクションゲーム

en.name: Goblin_Gnome_Horn
en.description: A 2D side-scrolling action game with hand-drawn graphics and a fun, surreal world view.

floor2.description: 少女たちと一緒に楽しく数学をやろう！

en.description: Let's do some easy math with the girls!

floor2.name: Glitchfall ~異変のある落ちものパズル~
floor2.shortName: GLITCHFALL ~異変のある落ちものパズル~
floor2.description: システムに異変を発見せよ！テトリス系パズルに観察ゲームをミックスした新感覚落ち物パズルゲームです。

en.name: Glitchfall
en.description: Detect system anomalies! A fresh take on falling block puzzles that mixes Tetris-style gameplay with observation challenges.

floor2.name: ✈️Velocity Wings✈️
floor2.description: これは、簡単に覚えられるのに信じられないほどやりがいのあるエンドレスフライトゲームです。絶えず変化する空を小さな飛行機で飛び回り、障害物を巧みに回避し、背後から迫りくる竜巻から必死に逃げましょう。一歩一歩が、技術と忍耐力の試練となります。

en.name: ✈️Velocity Wings✈️
en.description: This is an easy-to-learn yet incredibly challenging endless flight game. Control your little plane through the ever-changing sky, nimbly avoiding obstacles and desperately trying to escape the ever-approaching tornado behind you. Every advance is a test of skill and perseverance.

floor2.name: CINERIS SOMNIA
floor2.description: 『いつか君が、ぼくの夢を見てくれることを願ってる』少女たちの残酷で儚い夢。 「CINERIS SOMNIA」は、美しく奇妙で不可思議な世界を探索しながら物語を進めていく三人称視点の3Dアドベンチャーゲームです。

en.name: CINERIS SOMNIA
en.description: "I hope that someday, you'll dream of me." -- CINERIS SOMNIA is a 3D adventure through a beautifully strange and mesmerizing world - and a young girl's cruel and forlorn dreams.

floor2.name: Buckshot Roulette
floor2.description: ロシアンルーレット、12ゲージショットガン。入るは四人、出るは一人。命懸けの運試し。幸運を祈る。

en.name: Buckshot Roulette
en.description: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

floor2.name: ジョイアクアリウム
genres: クリーチャーコレクター
floor2.description: 『ジョイアクアリウム』は、気軽に楽しめる魚育成ゲーム。プレイヤーは稚魚を育てて高く売り、得たお金で水草や流木などを追加したり、水槽を自由にレイアウトできる（色調やサイズも調整可能）。さらに、設備やフィルター、壁紙、音楽など、カスタマイズ要素も充実している！

trailers.name: Can be used as wallpaper JP

en.name: Joyquarium
en.description: Joyquarium is a relaxing casual fish-raising game. Buy various cute fry and sell them at a high price after they grow up. With the money you earn, you can purchase aquatic plants, driftwood, scenery stone, etc. to decorate your tank (you can freely adjust the color, size, and position).

floor2.name: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
genres: 見下ろし型シューティング
floor2.description: こちらは、片手で全ての操作が可能なトップダウン視点の自動射撃型ローグライクゲームです。プレイヤーは悪夢の中に堕ちたピノキオとなり、禁断の力を宿す「夢の卵」を集めて、攻撃と生存の能力を自在に強化していきます。果てしない悪夢の中で、歪んだ童話の怪物たちを蹂躙しましょう！

en.name: Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors
en.description: This is a top-down, auto-shooting roguelike that can be played entirely one-handed. Players take on the role of Pinocchio, fallen into a nightmare, collecting forbidden Dream Eggs that grant ever-changing offensive and survival abilities. Slay twisted fairy tale creatures in endless nightmares!

floor2.name: マジキャット / MagiCat
floor2.description: 「ＭａｇｉＣａｔ」とは、16ビット時代のレトロゲームに触発されたサイドスクローラゲームです。このゲームでは、7つの世界を巡るかわいい魔法の猫が登場して、各世界にオリジナルなボスバトルがあります。最大63まで設定されたレベルデザインで、飽きることなく楽しめます。

en.name: MagiCat
en.description: MagiCat is a side-scrolling platformer inspired by the retro games from 16-bit era. The game features a cute magical cat adventuring 63 levels, each with their own unique boss battle spread across 7 worlds.

floor2.name: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ２
floor2.shortName: 古銭プッシャーフレンズ２
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 江戸時代を舞台にした、オンライン協力プレイ型のコインプッシャーゲーム「古銭プッシャーフレンズ」のシリーズ2作目です。他のプレイヤーと協力して妖怪を退治したり、どくろの大群を退けたり、ジャックポットを目指したりしましょう。ゲームを進めると様々な強化や装備で能力アップできます。

en.name: Old Coin Pusher Friends 2
en.description: "Old Coin Pusher Friends 2" is an online cooperative coin pusher game set in the Edo period. Players work together to defeat yokai, repel skulls, and aim for the jackpot. As the game progresses, players can upgrade their abilities and equipment to become stronger.

floor2.name: Love Letter
floor2.description: 姫に恋する何人もの若者たち…姫に恋文を渡すことができるのは誰？愛しい姫の心を手に入れるため、時にハッタリをかまし、時にはライバルを蹴落としながら、作戦を遂行しよう。 本作は、有名なカードゲームの公認を受けたデジタル版です。

en.name: Love Letter
en.description: The princess has several suitors... but which of them will manage to charm her? Choose a strategy, be it through bluffing or power of deduction, to win your beloved's heart. The official adaptation of the renowned card game.

floor2.name: 超増税都市
genres: ローグライクデッキ構築
floor2.description: 新感覚！？街づくり × ローグライトゲーム『超増税都市』。 ランダムに抽選される施設から、自分好みの施設を選んで配置しよう！ 組み合わせは無限大！あなただけの稼げる街を作ろう！

en.name: SuperTaxCity
en.description: A new sensation!? City-building × Roguelike game *Super Tax City*. Choose and place your favorite facilities from randomly drawn options! The combinations are endless! Create a profitable city that's uniquely yours!

floor2.name: holo8 -ホロハチ-
floor2.description: ループするホロライブ仮事務所から脱出しましょう。事務所をよく観察し、異変を見つけましょう。

en.name: holo8
en.description: Escape from the looping office. Observe the office carefully and look for any anomaly to reach the main entrance.

floor2.name: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris
floor2.description: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris is an intense mix of brick breaker, air hockey and bullet hell set in a post apocalyptic world. Destroy structures, dodge bullets, fire guns and buy perks to lay even more waste!

en.name: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris
en.description: DESTRUCTURE: Among Debris is an intense mix of brick breaker, air hockey and bullet hell set in a post apocalyptic world. Destroy structures, dodge bullets, fire guns and buy perks to lay even more waste!

floor2.name: 失踪 - タケシ、お前の言う通りだった。あの廃村はヤバすぎる。
floor2.shortName: 失踪 - タケシ、お前の言う通りだった。あの廃村はヤバすぎる。
floor2.description: 「失踪 -タケシ。お前の言う通りだった。 あの廃村はヤバすぎる。」は、 行方不明になった親友を探すべく日本の廃村を探索する 一人称視点のホラーコメディゲームです。

en.name: Disappearance - Takeshi. You were right. That Abandoned Village is Too Bad
en.description: "Disappearance - Takeshi. You were right. That Abandoned Village is Too Bad" is a first-person horror-comedy game in which you search an abandoned Japanese village for your missing best friend.

floor2.name: STAYHOMER
floor2.description: 全ての自粛違反者を”消毒”せよ

en.name: STAYHOMER
en.description: "Disinfect" all anti-lockdown protesters.

floor2.name: 10番商店街
floor2.description: ふと気がつくと、そこは見慣れない商店街でした。闇雲に進んでも入口に戻ってしまう異常な商店街。残されたヒントを頼りに、この商店街から脱出しましょう。

en.name: Shotengai 10
en.description: Suddenly, I realized that I was in a Japanese shopping district that I was unfamiliar with. An unusual shopping street where even if you proceed blindly, you will end up returning to the entrance. Let's exit from this shopping street by relying on the hints left behind.

floor2.name: Crazy Pocket
floor2.description: 『Crazy Pocket』は、ポケットビリヤードに着想を得たローグライク・デッキ構築ゲームです！ 多様な能力を組み合わせて強力なシナジーを生み出し、たった一撃のショットでテーブルを一掃する「最高のショット」を狙いましょう！

en.name: Crazy Pocket
en.description: Crazy Pocket is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic pocket billiards! Chain diverse ball abilities together to build game-breaking synergies, and execute the ultimate shot to clear the table in a single turn!

floor2.name: LOW VALUE JOB
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 机の上に散らばったボルトやナット、ワッシャーを種類ごとに仕分けるディストピア系の職業シミュレーションゲームです。あなたの仕事は、それらのパーツを一つずつ拾い上げ、観察し、正確に分類することです。オンライン対戦では世界中のプレイヤーと技術を競うことができます。

en.name: LOW VALUE JOB
en.description: LOW VALUE JOB is a dystopian job simulation game about sorting the bolts, nuts, and washers scattered across your desk by type. Your job is to pick up each part, examine it, and classify it accurately. In online matches, you can test your skills against players from around the world.

floor2.name: Car Parkour 2 Together
floor2.description: 伝説のパルクール・カオスが帰ってきた！Car Parkour 2 Togetherで1～2人プレイのアクションに飛び込もう。改良された物理演算で、巨大なランプや危険な新マップを攻略しよう。君たちの友情は生き残れるか？

en.name: Car Parkour 2 Together
en.description: The legendary parkour chaos is back! Dive into 1-2 player action in Car Parkour 2 Together. Master massive ramps and deadly new maps with improved physics. Can your friendship survive?

floor2.name: ミスカトニック大学美術部
floor2.shortName: ミスカトニック大学美術部
floor2.description: 「冒涜の泡をこぼしつづける、形のない混沌」……それ、どんな見た目！？ ミスカトニック大学美術部で、ネクロノミコンの挿絵を描いて当て合う、2〜8人のオンラインお絵描きゲーム。あなたのネクロノミコンに挿絵が増えていくごとに、トース部長との物語も少しずつ進行していきます。

en.name: Miskatonic University Art Club
en.description: "A formless chaos, spilling blasphemous bubbles"... what is that supposed to look like?! Illustrate the Necronomicon with the Miskatonic University Art Club in this online draw-and-guess game for 2–8 players.

floor2.name: Urbek City Builder
floor2.description: Urbek is a city building game where you can build your own neighbourhoods: from nightlife district to industrial district. Don't exhaust your natural resources before you have an educated population to build more efficient structures.

en.name: Urbek City Builder
en.description: Urbek is a city building game where you can build your own neighbourhoods: from nightlife district to industrial district. Don't exhaust your natural resources before you have an educated population to build more efficient structures.

floor2.name: にゃるるファイト！
genres: アクションアドベンチャー
floor2.description: 『にゃるるファイト！』は、可愛い猫娘が戦いまくる探索重視のメトロイドヴァニアだ。ある日突然、街に異変が訪れ、住民たちが猫になってしまった。世界の謎を追うためににゃるるの冒険の旅が始まる。

en.name: Nyaruru Fishy Fight
en.description: This game is a Metroidvania game with intense battle. Explore the world and collection power-ups with your cute cat girl! When magic curse suddenly occurred in a small town and all the residents grew cat ears, the real cat girl Nyaruru started her way to uncover the truth...

floor2.name: Down in Bermuda
floor2.description: おかしな嵐に巻き込まれたとある冒険飛行家が、何十年もの間、悪名高いバミューダに取り残されてしまいました。奥地に潜むクリーチャーを倒し、島の秘密を解き明かし、帰る方法を見つけましょう。

en.name: Down in Bermuda
en.description: An unnatural storm leaves an adventurous aviator stranded for decades within the infamous Bermuda. Overcome creatures of the deep and unravel the islands secrets in search of a way back home.

floor2.name: Destropolis
genres: 見下ろし型シューティング
一騎当千方式シューティング
floor2.description: デストロポリスは、完全に破壊可能な環境、何百もの敵と核爆発を持つトップダウンシューティングゲームです。敵の無数の大群と戦います。弾丸、レーザー、爆発でそれらをバラバラにしてください。彼らはあなたを圧倒する前に、それらの多くを破壊することができます。

en.name: Destropolis
en.description: Destropolis is a top-down shooter game with a fully destructible environment, hundreds of enemies and nuclear explosions. Fight a countless swarm of enemies. Tear them to pieces with bullets, lasers and explosions. Destroy as many of them as you can before they overwhelm you...

floor2.name: Fight School Simulator
genres: 没入シミュレーション
floor2.description: 伝説の武道師範になる準備はできていますか？自分の道場を立ち上げ、弟子たちを鍛え、ライバル道場と戦い最強を目指そう。大会に参加し、バッタを育て、そして最も大切なことは、弟子たちから授業料を集めることです！

en.name: Fight School Simulator
en.description: Are you ready to become a legendary martial arts master? Build your own school, train your students, and battle rival schools to become the strongest. Join tournaments, raise your grasshoppers, and most importantly, collect tuition from your students!

floor2.name: 雪女ちゃんチェッカー
floor2.shortName: 雪女ちゃんチェッカー
floor2.description: ❄️雪女ちゃんは冷たい温度が大好きだよ。パソコンを壊さないよう気をつけながら、雪女ちゃんを喜ばせてあげよう！ゲームや作業のお供にもおすすめのデスクトップマスコット❄️

en.name: Yuki-Onna Checker
en.description: ❄️ Yuki-Onna loves cold temperatures. Be careful not to overheat your PC while making her happy! A desktop mascot that’s perfect to keep you company while gaming or working. ❄️

floor2.name: サカバンバスピスクロニクル
floor2.shortName: サカバンバスピスクロニクル
floor2.description: プレイヤーはサカバンバスピスとなって海を泳ぎながら、プランクトンを食べて成長したり進化したりしながら、 サカバンバスピスの仲間たちと日々を生きます。サカバンバスピスの仲間たちとの物語を進めながら、最後はどうなるのかを見届けてください。

en.name: Sacabambaspis Chronicle
en.description: As a player, you become Sacabambaspis and live each day with your fellow Sacabambaspis, growing and evolving by swimming in the sea and eating plankton. Progress through the story with your companions in Sacabambaspis, and see what happens in the end.

floor2.name: Hidden Pets: 101 Cats in Tokyo
floor2.description: この冒険に参加して、手作りの東京の風景の中に隠れている101匹の子猫🐾を見つけよう。🏆たくさんの実績を獲得しよう。何匹見つけられるかな😺？🔎急いで！⏱️

trailers.name: TRAILER - 101 Cats in Tokyo - PLAY NOW!

en.name: Hidden Pets: 101 Cats in Tokyo
en.description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens 🐾 in the hand-crafted Tokyo landscape. 🏆 Earn lots of achievements. How many 😺 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

floor2.name: The Witch's Isle
floor2.description: 幻想的な孤島の町を舞台にしたアドベンチャーゲーム

en.name: The Witch's Isle
en.description: An adventure game that takes place in a dream-like town on a solitary island.

floor2.name: 人形の傷跡
floor2.description: 『FolksSoul -失われた伝承-』のシナリオライターが贈る、サイコホラー・アドベンチャーゲームがSteamに登場。主人公の上条明日美（かみじょう あすみ）は、3か月ほど前から音信不通の姉を探すべく単身上京する。姉の在籍している大学院を訪ねるも、そこでは誰もが姉の存在を「知らない」と言う。皆が故意にウソをついているのか、それとも明日美がおかしくなってしまったのか・・・

en.name: Scar of the Doll
en.description: Scar of the Doll is a beloved '90s visual novel remastered for Steam. Asumi goes to Tokyo to search for her only sister whom she has mysteriously not heard from for months. With an intelligent and unpredictable story, uncover a frightening truth in this thrilling suspense mystery.

floor2.name: 絶対遵守
floor2.description: 🌐 言語不要 【規則は絶対。破れば即、＂死＂】無人の雑居ビルからの脱出を目指す、一人称視点の短編脱出デスゲーム。ランダムに変化する規則を絶対に守り抜き、ギミックを突破して脱出せよ。

en.name: No exceptions
en.description: 🌐 Language Independent “Rules are absolute. Break them, and you die. No Exceptions.” Escape a building from the 10th floor in this death game. Each floor has prohibited actions. Break a rule and it’s game over. Don’t run. Don’t stop. Don’t look. Learn the rules. Obey them. Escape alive.

floor2.name: Q2 HUMANITY
floor2.description: 物理演算ゲーム『Q REMASTERED』の続編『Q2 HUMANITY』は、“描く”だけではなく”人間 ”が登場。 “人間”が飛んだり跳ねたり投げたり、時には特殊能力を発揮したり。『Q2』は、1人はもちろん、最大4人まで遊ぶことができます。描いて人間を操って数多のステージに挑戦しよう！

en.name: Q2 HUMANITY
en.description: The sequel to the physics-based puzzle game 'Q REMASTERED,' titled 'Q2 HUMANITY,' introduces characters or 'humans' that now appear in the game. These 'humans' can jump, bounce, throw things, and sometimes even exhibit special abilities. 'Q2' can be played solo or with up to 4 players.

floor2.name: マジック・アウェイクニング：ヒーローサーガ
floor2.shortName: マジック・アウェイクニング：ヒーローサーガ
floor2.description: 弾幕シューティング、インベントリ管理、タワーディフェンスを融合した戦略ローグライク。ヒーローを招募・合成・進化し、女神を召喚、城を強化してモンスターの波を防げ。100以上のステージ、メタ進行、低スペック対応。

en.name: Magic Awakening：Hero Saga
en.description: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.

floor2.name: Chocolate makes you happy 6
floor2.description: 『Chocolate makes you happy 6』はクッキーとチョコ、反重力、ベルトコンベア、ジャンプ台が登場する2D物理パズルゲームです。50のステージでチョコバーの上にクッキーを乗せましょう。罠や爆発を避け、論理力と正確性を試そう！

en.name: Chocolate makes you happy 6
en.description: Chocolate makes you happy 6 is a colorful 2D physics puzzle game with cookies, chocolate, reverse gravity, treadmills, jumpers, teleports, and accelerators. Keep cookies on a chocolate bar across 50 levels, dodge traps and explosions, and test your logic, timing, and precision.

floor2.name: TAKIBI
floor2.description: 日常の忙しさや冷たさを忘れ、時に炎を見つめ、そして自分を見つめる。 そんな時間があってもいいのではないでしょうか。

en.name: TAKIBI
en.description: Forgetting the busyness and coldness of daily life, we sometimes gaze at the flames and then at ourselves. It would be nice to have such a time.

floor2.name: Bunker Tidy Up
floor2.description: Bunker Tidy Upは、バンカーを整理整頓するリラックス系ゲームです。17,437個の物資を棚に並べ、資源をカテゴリー分けしながら、ゆったり楽しみましょう！

en.name: Bunker Tidy Up
en.description: Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a bunker. Arrange 17,437 supplies on shelves, categorize resources, and relax!

floor2.name: Alicemare
floor2.description: 記憶とそして両親をうしなった主人公アレン。とある施設で暮らす彼は、決して開けてはならないと言われた扉を、開けてしまいます。そこは、ヒトのココロを映し出した奇怪な世界。ヒトのココロ、のぞくべからず。

en.name: Alicemare
en.description: Alicemare is a somehow familiar yet totally unique adventure game infused with subtle hints of horror, created by △○□× (Miwashiba) using the WOLF RPG Editor.

floor2.name: 五目並べ レッツゴー
floor2.shortName: 五目並べ レッツゴー
floor2.description: 五目並べは年齢問わず楽しめる碁盤を使ったゲーム。禅のビジュアルにリアルタイムのオンラインモード、色んな難易度のAIと厳選された50種の局面に挑戦できる。

en.name: Gomoku Let's Go
en.description: Gomoku: One of the most popular classic board games for all ages. Experience Zen style visuals, various levels of AI, seamless online multiplayer and Endgame challenges!

floor2.name: Tchia
floor2.description: トロピカルなオープンワールドを冒険しよう。この物理サンドボックスで、美しい島々を登ったり、滑空したり、泳いだり、船を出したりしよう。見つけた動物やオブジェクトをコントロールし、本物のように演奏可能なウクレレでセッションしよう。

en.name: Tchia
en.description: A Tropical Open-World adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele.

floor2.name: 『You Suck at Parking®』、とめられるもんならとめてみな
floor2.shortName: 『YOU SUCK AT PARKING』、とめられるもんならとめてみな
floor2.description: 『You Suck at Parking™』は、停車することが目標となる前代未聞のレーシングゲームだ。カラフルだけど一筋縄ではいかない、この進化を続けるこのパーキングシミュレーターゲームでクルマをカスタマイズし、世界に挑もう。

trailers.name: You Suck at Parking - Complete Edition
You Suck at Parking - Launch Trailer - Simplified Chinese

en.name: You Suck at Parking® - Complete Edition
en.description: You Suck at Parking® is the only racing game where your goal is to stop and parking your ride is more important than your driving skills. It’s a hot race against the clock as you drift, cruise, and go airborne over 250 frustratingly fun, wild levels.

floor2.name: Clock Simulator
floor2.description: Clock Simulator is a mindful game of rhythm and focus in which YOU are the clock. Click once a second, every second. Don't be late. Don't hurry. There's nothing else to be concerned with. Clear your mind and discover new depths of relaxation while becoming time itself!

trailers.name: How do you play Clock Simulator, the mindful game of rhythm and focus

en.name: Clock Simulator
en.description: Clock Simulator is a mindful game of rhythm and focus in which YOU are the clock. Click once a second, every second. Don't be late. Don't hurry. There's nothing else to be concerned with. Clear your mind and discover new depths of relaxation while becoming time itself!

floor2.name: Between Horizons – A Sci-Fi Detective Adventure
floor2.shortName: BETWEEN HORIZONS – A SCI-FI DETECTIVE AD
floor2.description: 『Between Horizons』は、ナラティブな2.5次元SF探偵アドベンチャーである。ゼファー号の旅が始まって33年、そのミッションが突然危険にさらされる。手遅れになる前に犯人を見つけることができるのか？ 君の選択によって枝分かれし、様々な結末を迎えるセミオープンワールドを舞台にした魅惑的なストーリーを体験しよう。

en.name: Between Horizons – A Sci-Fi Detective Adventure
en.description: Between Horizons is a narrative 2.5D sci-fi detective adventure. 33 years into the Zephyr's journey, its mission is suddenly jeopardized. Can you find the culprit before it's too late? Experience an enthralling story set in a semi-open world that branches and ends based on your choices.

floor2.name: Slimeward
floor2.description: Slimewardは、プレイヤーが村を建設・強化し、英雄を募集して、ある日家の前に現れたモンスター「スライム」を倒す放置ゲームです。

en.name: Slimeward
en.description: Slimeward is an idle game where players build and upgrade a village, recruit heroes, and defeat Monster 'Slime' that fell in front of the house one day,

en.name: Deadlock
en.description: Deadlock is a multiplayer game in early development.

en.name: Dear Passengers
en.description: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

en.name: Light No Fire
en.description: A game about adventure, building, survival and exploration together. Set on a fantasy planet the size of Earth.

en.name: Fable
en.description: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

en.name: Blight: Survival
en.description: Blight: Survival is a PvE Action-Horror Game set in a brutal medieval world. Play in solo or team-up with up to 3 friends as you face monsters and men in a tense battle for survival. How far are you willing to go?

en.name: Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000
en.description: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

en.name: Resident Evil Veronica
en.description: Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica. In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

en.name: Kingmakers
en.description: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

en.name: Witchbrook
en.description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

en.name: ILL
en.description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

en.name: ARK 2
en.description: Survive the past. Tame the future. Suddenly awakened on a primal world filled with dinosaurs and humans struggling for dominance, you must team-up with legendary heroes to confront powerful dark forces. Saddle up, and join the definitive next-gen survival experience with ARK 2!

en.name: Soulframe
en.description: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.

en.name: METRO 2039
en.description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

en.name: Unrecord
en.description: Unrecord is a single-player FPS that tells the story of a tactical police officer from the perspective of his body camera. As you work to solve a complex case, you'll need to use your tactical and detective skills to succeed.

en.name: Persona 4 Revival
en.description: Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
en.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

en.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
en.description: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

en.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
en.description: Experience a stunning reimagining of Lara Croft’s debut adventure to discover the lost secrets of Atlantis with jaw-dropping visuals, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

en.name: Tides of Annihilation
en.description: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.

en.name: Chrono Odyssey
en.description: Chrono Odyssey, A Next-generation Action MMORPG. Game features include awe-inspiring visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, a vast and intricately designed seamless open world, dynamic action-based combat mechanics based on time manipulation and extensive customization.

en.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
en.description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

en.name: State of Decay 3
en.description: Play as a community of survivors, build up your settlements with friends, and destroy zombies in State of Decay 3, the latest in the franchise from developer Undead Labs.

en.name: NAKWON: LAST PARADISE
en.description: NAKWON is a multiplayer zombie survival game set in urban South Korea. Venture into the city in the dead of night, and manage your shelter by day. Scavenge resources in a city crawling with the infected and hostile survivors. Survival is the only rule - trust no one, not even the living.

en.name: Vindictus: Defying Fate
en.description: Experience intense action brought to life with diverse, unique characters. Read your enemy’s attacks and strike back for maximum impact in Vindictus: Defying Fate. Immerse yourself in signature combat and a gripping narrative.

en.name: Chronicles: Medieval
en.description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

en.name: Railborn
en.description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

en.name: PUBG: Black Budget
en.description: PUBG: Black Budget is an extraction shooter built around tension, survival, and the unknown. Join a classified operation and uncover the secrets of a mysterious island trapped in a time loop.

en.name: Rooted
en.description: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

en.name: Alkahest
en.description: Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.

upcoming.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State

en.name: Rules of Engagement: The Grey State
en.description: A horror-infused extraction shooter for squads of three. Crush monster hordes with devastating firepower in co-op PvE, or take on rival squads for The Vertex in PvP. Choose your battle, push as far as you dare, and make it out alive.

en.name: Persona 6
en.description: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.

en.name: Emberville
en.description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

en.name: Showa American Story
en.description: Showa American Story is an RPG steeped in retro pop culture. In the late 1980s, a dominant Japan culturally colonized America. Resurrected from the grave, Chigusa Choko embarks on a road trip of combat, exploration, and growth across a world both absurd and strangely familiar.

en.name: Falling Frontier
en.description: Conquer a vast procedurally generated star system in Falling Frontier, a sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields and construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae.

en.name: Ardem
en.description: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

en.name: Guild Wars 3™
en.description: Guild Wars 3 is an action-adventure MMORPG, a modern evolution of the genre that blends rich action-combat, character building, and skill collection. Set in the enchanting frontier of Orr, the world brims with mystery, magic, and wonder.

en.name: Haunted Paws
en.description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

en.name: Beautiful Light
en.description: Beautiful Light, a PvPvPvE tactical first-person extraction shooter where 6 squads of 3 operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a hostile, horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

en.name: The Bustling World
en.description: The Bustling World is an open-world RPG set in a fictional ancient China. Enjoy boundless freedom with features such as farming, crafting, building, management, crime, and exploration. Recruit your own army, stabilize the regime, and engage in diplomacy for an immersive experience.

en.name: NO LAW
en.description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

en.name: GrimKeep
en.description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

en.name: Launch Window
en.description: Launch Window is a single player physics-based automation game where you establish supply chains across an entire solar system using orbital mechanics.

en.name: Second Stone
en.description: Second Stone is a colorful Action RPG built around two fully playable parallel worlds. Play as Shiren, a young treasure hunter who can cross between the vibrant Light World and its sinister mirror, the Shrouded World. Master fast-paced combat and forge your path to power with elemental Manastones.

en.name: NOIR BLOOM
en.description: NOIR BLOOM is a high-octane 2D Gun-Fu action game, where adrenaline-fueled gunfights and skull-crushing close combat collide in a neo-noir rhapsody. Embark on a deadly rampage to honor the vow—strike, disarm, and turn foes into weapons. Every move is a calculated ballet of bullets and blood.

en.name: Escape the Scam Compound
en.description: Lured by a fake high-pay job you're trapped in a scam compound. Teamwork is the only way out! In this 4-player co-op escape, get past guards and solve mechanical puzzles. Multiple side quests let you rescue victims and shape endings; anti-fraud knowledge woven in. Get out alive. Will you break free?

en.name: MOLTYN
en.description: MOLTYN: Superhero destruction sandbox where every pixel is simulated: rock, water, lava, ice and metal melt, flood, freeze and collapse for real. Every power of the earth, 18 missions, kaiju fights, free-play worlds and CREATE, a level editor with level sharing. Early Access 12 Nov 2026.

en.name: Human Farm
en.description: Welcome to Human Farm🐽 – an alternate, Orwellian world where Pigs became the dominant species. Humans are degraded to farmed meat. Create and develop your own slaughterhouse. Your goal: conquer and dominate the human meat industry. Millions of hungry snouts are waiting to be fed!

en.name: Prospera
en.description: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

en.name: THE SIGNAL: Stranded on Sirenis
en.description: Crash-landed on the alien world of Sirenis, you must survive, build a base and search for your missing brother. Gather, research and craft your way across a hostile planet of strange creatures, ancient ruins and a mystery far bigger than your crash.

en.name: Biofactory
en.description: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. You are an evolving hive-mind brain, driven by one instinct: The factory must grow.

en.name: Over Jump Rally
en.description: RALLY! Hot blazing sun! Relive arcade racing with Over Jump Rally – an unofficial remake of Sega Rally from the '90s. Unreal Engine 5-powered stunning graphics, nostalgic music, and intuitive controls bring classic racing to a new generation. Easy, right? Maybe!

en.name: ASKET
en.description: Go to the vicinity of the “dead city”. A mystical place, full of strange anomalies, wild creatures, rare artifacts and ascetics!

en.name: GIMMIKO
en.description: Demons from the collective subconcious are leaking into reality. Save the world from the curse of the Jabberwock in this wacky dicebuilding twinstick action roguelite!

en.name: Steel Bounty
en.description: Dive into an immersive first-person mech simulation featuring extensive customization and mercenary company management. Battle for glory and wealth in a dynamic campaign where your choices shape the course of the war.

en.name: Rover's Tale
en.description: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

en.name: Afterconflict
en.description: A brutal tactical FPS focusing on unflinching realism and equipment accuracy, set during the twilight days of what was once the Cold War.

en.name: BOMBSHELL BLITZ
en.description: BOMBSHELL BLITZ is an explosive twin-stick tank shooter with minor roguelite elements. Upgrade your tank and ace your combat exams to impress your cute supervisors with the highest scores you can!

en.name: Burn-9
en.description: A spy thriller where you’re not the spy. Safe behind your screen, guide the last survivor of an elite black-ops team in a desperate attempt to salvage a mission gone horribly wrong. Caught between military command and your agent, information is your greatest weapon.

upcoming.name: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga

en.name: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga
en.description: Lufia and its sequel, Lufia II, return! In a love letter to JRPG fans, these two dramatic tales of love and loss, which moved countless players to tears, are back!

en.name: Ethernia
en.description: 2D pixel art MMORPG with real-time combat, gathering, crafting, and immersive storytelling. Evolve your class, fight monsters, and discover if you're the Heir of Ethernia.

en.name: SILENT DOOM
en.description: SILENT DOOM is an atmospheric first-person survival horror adventure set in a nightmarish universe. Gameplay consists of combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving. It is designed around the idea of "being thrown into the world". Isolated and lost inside this nightmare world.

en.name: AMAKANO 3
en.description: A lazy summer visual novel comedy from hit developer AZARASHI SOFTWARE! Take up a position as a dorm manager in a hot-spring town and nurture new connections with its colorful cast of residents!

en.name: Hibernaculum
en.description: Hibernaculum is a retro inspired dungeon crawler that sets out to recreate the engrossing labyrinthine experiences of the classics of days gone by, whilst also building a modern, deeply unique & explorable world of survival, mystery and macabre intrigue.

en.name: My Otter Friends
en.description: Explore a flooded island as a small otter. Meet stranded animals, restore nature, and bring warmth back to a world that has grown quiet.

en.name: Neidfyre
en.description: Neidfyre is a turn-based duel game forged in fire and steel. Step into a cursed land of no escape. Survive against those who stand in your way and fulfill your purpose.

en.name: Dinos Reborn
en.description: Immerse yourself in the world of Dinos Reborn and feel like a dinosaur hunter! Danger awaits you at every turn. Think fast and don't hesitate, because every second lost can turn you from hunter to prey...

en.name: Dragonscale Monastery
en.description: Discover the secrets of dragon breeding. Survive harsh winters, limited resources, hunger, cold, and many other adversities. Experience unique survival city-builder in the world of Dragonscale Monastery.

en.name: INANIMA
en.description: A survival horror game set in the isolated facilities of a strange corporation. Search for limited supplies, and fight terrifying creatures to reveal the truth behind the Lazarus project. Be part of something that will change the future of humanity.

upcoming.name: Broken Sword - The Smoking Mirror: Reforged

en.name: Broken Sword - The Smoking Mirror: Reforged
en.description: The classic award winning adventure returns in glorious 4K with fully remastered audio. Step into the shoes of intrepid tourist George Stobbart and sharp-witted journalist Nico Collard as they unravel a deadly Mayan conspiracy steeped in ancient artifacts and dark magic.

en.name: SimBus
en.description: SimBus is new, advanced bus simulator. Drive historic and modern vehicles from all parts of the world. Visit living cities of USA, Europe and China in different eras. Become bus driver, follow the timetable and meet other players on multiplayer mode.

en.name: Heavy Duty Construction
en.description: Become a construction worker - demolish, design and build using heavy machinery. Expand your abilities and unlock a variety of vehicles to build your construction company empire. Renovate and manage cities in this heavy machines simulation game.

en.name: Ordinary Oddness
en.description: Ordinary Oddness is a Nothing-Stays-Oddinary Open-World RPG. Since the Albinox Judgment, humans and Mythoids have lived side by side in Elysian Skies, a city suspended above a sea of clouds, sharing the same streets and the same everyday rules.

en.name: Jerma's Big Adventure 2
en.description: Become Jerma. In this genre-jumping absurdist adventure, scramble to appease a restless livestream audience by hopping between in-universe video games. Enter the Jermaverse...

en.name: Times of Survival
en.description: Times of Survival is a co-op zombie survival game with souls-like inspired combat system, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Fortify your base, fight hordes of zombies and battle epic bosses. Explore, craft, and master punishing combat while building your settlement and leading survivors to hope.

en.name: BPM Bitcrushed
en.description: BPM Bitcrushed: A retro roguelite rhythm shooter where every shot, dodge, and jump must sync to the beat. Battle through dungeons where enemies attack in time with the music. Find epic loot and even import your own songs to create a custom, rhythm-fuelled soundtrack for your destruction!

en.name: Age of Transport - Blue Marble
en.description: Classification yards, waybills and live dispatch — on a 1:4-scale Earth. Build a multi-modal freight empire across rail, sea and air through twelve eras of transport history, in a persistent world shared by up to 255 companies.

en.name: Phantom Doctrine: The Cabal
en.description: Explore the world in Phantom Doctrine: The Cabal to work out a dangerous terrorist organization in various locations around the globe. From exotic rainforests and secluded corners to bustling large metropolises.

en.name: Grave Mistakes
en.description: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

en.name: FUMEHEAD
en.description: FUMEHEAD is a hero-focused turn-based RPG set in a post-abandonment underground world. Play as Jack & Ami as you try to eradicate the new alien disease that calls itself Slither.
